var _emscripten_glUniformMatrix2fv = (location, count, transpose, value) => {
  if (GL.currentContext.version >= 2) {
    count && GLctx.uniformMatrix2fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, HEAPF32, ((value) >> 2), count * 4);
    return;
  }
  if (count <= 72) {
    // avoid allocation when uploading few enough uniforms
    count *= 4;
    var view = miniTempWebGLFloatBuffers[count];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 4) {
      view[i] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 1] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 4)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 2] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 8)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 3] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 12)) >> 2)];
    }
  } else {
    var view = HEAPF32.subarray((((value) >> 2)), ((value + count * 16) >> 2));
  }
  GLctx.uniformMatrix2fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, view);
};

var _glUniformMatrix2fv = _emscripten_glUniformMatrix2fv;

var _emscripten_glUniformMatrix3fv = (location, count, transpose, value) => {
  if (GL.currentContext.version >= 2) {
    count && GLctx.uniformMatrix3fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, HEAPF32, ((value) >> 2), count * 9);
    return;
  }
  if (count <= 32) {
    // avoid allocation when uploading few enough uniforms
    count *= 9;
    var view = miniTempWebGLFloatBuffers[count];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 9) {
      view[i] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 1] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 4)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 2] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 8)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 3] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 12)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 4] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 16)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 5] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 20)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 6] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 24)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 7] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 28)) >> 2)];
      view[i + 8] = HEAPF32[(((value) + (4 * i + 32)) >> 2)];
    }
  } else {
    var view = HEAPF32.subarray((((value) >> 2)), ((value + count * 36) >> 2));
  }
  GLctx.uniformMatrix3fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, view);
};

var _glUniformMatrix3fv = _emscripten_glUniformMatrix3fv;

var _emscripten_glUniformMatrix4fv = (location, count, transpose, value) => {
  if (GL.currentContext.version >= 2) {
    count && GLctx.uniformMatrix4fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, HEAPF32, ((value) >> 2), count * 16);
    return;
  }
  if (count <= 18) {
    // avoid allocation when uploading few enough uniforms
    var view = miniTempWebGLFloatBuffers[16 * count];
    // hoist the heap out of the loop for size and for pthreads+growth.
    var heap = HEAPF32;
    value = ((value) >> 2);
    count *= 16;
    for (var i = 0; i < count; i += 16) {
      var dst = value + i;
      view[i] = heap[dst];
      view[i + 1] = heap[dst + 1];
      view[i + 2] = heap[dst + 2];
      view[i + 3] = heap[dst + 3];
      view[i + 4] = heap[dst + 4];
      view[i + 5] = heap[dst + 5];
      view[i + 6] = heap[dst + 6];
      view[i + 7] = heap[dst + 7];
      view[i + 8] = heap[dst + 8];
      view[i + 9] = heap[dst + 9];
      view[i + 10] = heap[dst + 10];
      view[i + 11] = heap[dst + 11];
      view[i + 12] = heap[dst + 12];
      view[i + 13] = heap[dst + 13];
      view[i + 14] = heap[dst + 14];
      view[i + 15] = heap[dst + 15];
    }
  } else {
    var view = HEAPF32.subarray((((value) >> 2)), ((value + count * 64) >> 2));
  }
  GLctx.uniformMatrix4fv(webglGetUniformLocation(location), !!transpose, view);
};

var _glUniformMatrix4fv = _emscripten_glUniformMatrix4fv;

var _emscripten_glUseProgram = program => {
  program = GL.programs[program];
  GLctx.useProgram(program);
  // Record the currently active program so that we can access the uniform
  // mapping table of that program.
  GLctx.currentProgram = program;
};

var _glUseProgram = _emscripten_glUseProgram;

var _emscripten_glVertexAttribPointer = (index, size, type, normalized, stride, ptr) => {
  var cb = GL.currentContext.clientBuffers[index];
  if (!GLctx.currentArrayBufferBinding) {
    cb.size = size;
    cb.type = type;
    cb.normalized = normalized;
    cb.stride = stride;
    cb.ptr = ptr;
    cb.clientside = true;
    cb.vertexAttribPointerAdaptor = function(index, size, type, normalized, stride, ptr) {
      this.vertexAttribPointer(index, size, type, normalized, stride, ptr);
    };
    return;
  }
  cb.clientside = false;
  GLctx.vertexAttribPointer(index, size, type, !!normalized, stride, ptr);
};

var _glVertexAttribPointer = _emscripten_glVertexAttribPointer;

var _emscripten_glViewport = (x0, x1, x2, x3) => GLctx.viewport(x0, x1, x2, x3);

var _glViewport = _emscripten_glViewport;

function _mediapipe_find_canvas_event_target(canvasSelector) {
  let target = findCanvasEventTarget(canvasSelector);
  // WebGPU-on-worker uses this function to try to grab the canvas, but
  // doesn't have a DOM element to find. So as a quick patch, if the default
  // behavior is unsuccessful here then we try a webgpu canvas property
  // which is set by the user directly on the Module, much like how our old
  // pipeline used the Module.canvas property. See b/265271517 for details.
  if (Module && !target) {
    target = Module.canvasWebGpu;
  }
  return Emval.toHandle(target);
}

function _mediapipe_webgl_tex_image_drawable(drawableHandle) {
  const drawable = Emval.toValue(drawableHandle);
  GLctx.texImage2D(GLctx.TEXTURE_2D, 0, GLctx.RGBA, GLctx.RGBA, GLctx.UNSIGNED_BYTE, drawable);
}

var _random_get = (buffer, size) => randomFill(HEAPU8.subarray(buffer, buffer + size));

var _wgpuCommandEncoderBeginComputePass = (encoderPtr, descriptor) => {
  var desc;
  if (descriptor) {
    desc = {
      "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
      "timestampWrites": WebGPU.makePassTimestampWrites(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (12)) >> 2)])
    };
  }
  var commandEncoder = WebGPU.getJsObject(encoderPtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateComputePassEncoder(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, commandEncoder.beginComputePass(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuCommandEncoderBeginRenderPass = (encoderPtr, descriptor) => {
  function makeColorAttachment(caPtr) {
    var viewPtr = HEAPU32[(((caPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    if (viewPtr === 0) {
      // Null `view` means no attachment in this slot.
      return undefined;
    }
    var depthSlice = HEAPU32[(((caPtr) + (8)) >> 2)];
    if (depthSlice == 4294967295) depthSlice = undefined;
    return {
      "view": WebGPU.getJsObject(viewPtr),
      "depthSlice": depthSlice,
      "resolveTarget": WebGPU.getJsObject(HEAPU32[(((caPtr) + (12)) >> 2)]),
      "clearValue": WebGPU.makeColor(caPtr + 24),
      "loadOp": WebGPU.LoadOp[HEAP32[(((caPtr) + (16)) >> 2)]],
      "storeOp": WebGPU.StoreOp[HEAP32[(((caPtr) + (20)) >> 2)]]
    };
  }
  function makeColorAttachments(count, caPtr) {
    var attachments = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
      attachments.push(makeColorAttachment(caPtr + 56 * i));
    }
    return attachments;
  }
  function makeDepthStencilAttachment(dsaPtr) {
    if (dsaPtr === 0) return undefined;
    return {
      "view": WebGPU.getJsObject(HEAPU32[(((dsaPtr) + (4)) >> 2)]),
      "depthClearValue": HEAPF32[(((dsaPtr) + (16)) >> 2)],
      "depthLoadOp": WebGPU.LoadOp[HEAP32[(((dsaPtr) + (8)) >> 2)]],
      "depthStoreOp": WebGPU.StoreOp[HEAP32[(((dsaPtr) + (12)) >> 2)]],
      "depthReadOnly": !!(HEAPU32[(((dsaPtr) + (20)) >> 2)]),
      "stencilClearValue": HEAPU32[(((dsaPtr) + (32)) >> 2)],
      "stencilLoadOp": WebGPU.LoadOp[HEAP32[(((dsaPtr) + (24)) >> 2)]],
      "stencilStoreOp": WebGPU.StoreOp[HEAP32[(((dsaPtr) + (28)) >> 2)]],
      "stencilReadOnly": !!(HEAPU32[(((dsaPtr) + (36)) >> 2)])
    };
  }
  function makeRenderPassDescriptor(descriptor) {
    var nextInChainPtr = HEAPU32[((descriptor) >> 2)];
    var maxDrawCount = undefined;
    if (nextInChainPtr !== 0) {
      var sType = HEAP32[(((nextInChainPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
      var renderPassMaxDrawCount = nextInChainPtr;
      // Note: The user could have passed a really huge value here, which is technically valid in
      // C but will not be allowed by WebGPU in JS because of [EnforceRange]. We intentionally
      // ignore that case because it's not useful - apps can just pick a smaller maxDrawCount.
      maxDrawCount = readI53FromI64((renderPassMaxDrawCount) + (8));
    }
    var desc = {
      "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
      "colorAttachments": makeColorAttachments(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (12)) >> 2)], HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (16)) >> 2)]),
      "depthStencilAttachment": makeDepthStencilAttachment(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (20)) >> 2)]),
      "occlusionQuerySet": WebGPU.getJsObject(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (24)) >> 2)]),
      "timestampWrites": WebGPU.makePassTimestampWrites(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (28)) >> 2)]),
      "maxDrawCount": maxDrawCount
    };
    return desc;
  }
  var desc = makeRenderPassDescriptor(descriptor);
  var commandEncoder = WebGPU.getJsObject(encoderPtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateRenderPassEncoder(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, commandEncoder.beginRenderPass(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuDeviceCreateBindGroup = (devicePtr, descriptor) => {
  function makeEntry(entryPtr) {
    var bufferPtr = HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (8)) >> 2)];
    var samplerPtr = HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (32)) >> 2)];
    var textureViewPtr = HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (36)) >> 2)];
    var externalTexturePtr = 0;
    WebGPU.iterateExtensions(entryPtr, {
      14: ptr => {
        externalTexturePtr = HEAPU32[(((ptr) + (8)) >> 2)];
      }
    });
    var resource;
    if (bufferPtr) {
      // Note the sentinel UINT64_MAX will be read as -1.
      var size = readI53FromI64((entryPtr) + (24));
      if (size == -1) size = undefined;
      resource = {
        "buffer": WebGPU.getJsObject(bufferPtr),
        "offset": readI53FromI64((entryPtr) + (16)),
        "size": size
      };
    } else {
      resource = WebGPU.getJsObject(samplerPtr || textureViewPtr || externalTexturePtr);
    }
    return {
      "binding": HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (4)) >> 2)],
      "resource": resource
    };
  }
  function makeEntries(count, entriesPtrs) {
    var entries = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
      entries.push(makeEntry(entriesPtrs + 40 * i));
    }
    return entries;
  }
  var desc = {
    "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
    "layout": WebGPU.getJsObject(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (12)) >> 2)]),
    "entries": makeEntries(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (16)) >> 2)], HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (20)) >> 2)])
  };
  var device = WebGPU.getJsObject(devicePtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateBindGroup(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, device.createBindGroup(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuDeviceCreateBindGroupLayout = (devicePtr, descriptor) => {
  function makeBufferEntry(substructPtr) {
    var typeInt = HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    if (!typeInt) return undefined;
    return {
      "type": WebGPU.BufferBindingType[typeInt],
      "hasDynamicOffset": !!(HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (8)) >> 2)]),
      "minBindingSize": readI53FromI64((substructPtr) + (16))
    };
  }
  function makeSamplerEntry(substructPtr) {
    var typeInt = HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    if (!typeInt) return undefined;
    return {
      "type": WebGPU.SamplerBindingType[typeInt]
    };
  }
  function makeTextureEntry(substructPtr) {
    var sampleTypeInt = HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    if (!sampleTypeInt) return undefined;
    return {
      "sampleType": WebGPU.TextureSampleType[sampleTypeInt],
      "viewDimension": WebGPU.TextureViewDimension[HEAP32[(((substructPtr) + (8)) >> 2)]],
      "multisampled": !!(HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (12)) >> 2)])
    };
  }
  function makeStorageTextureEntry(substructPtr) {
    var accessInt = HEAPU32[(((substructPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    if (!accessInt) return undefined;
    return {
      "access": WebGPU.StorageTextureAccess[accessInt],
      "format": WebGPU.TextureFormat[HEAP32[(((substructPtr) + (8)) >> 2)]],
      "viewDimension": WebGPU.TextureViewDimension[HEAP32[(((substructPtr) + (12)) >> 2)]]
    };
  }
  function makeEntry(entryPtr) {
    var entry = {
      "binding": HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (4)) >> 2)],
      "visibility": HEAPU32[(((entryPtr) + (8)) >> 2)],
      "buffer": makeBufferEntry(entryPtr + 24),
      "sampler": makeSamplerEntry(entryPtr + 48),
      "texture": makeTextureEntry(entryPtr + 56),
      "storageTexture": makeStorageTextureEntry(entryPtr + 72)
    };
    WebGPU.iterateExtensions(entryPtr, {
      13: ptr => {
        entry["externalTexture"] = {};
      }
    });
    return entry;
  }
  function makeEntries(count, entriesPtrs) {
    var entries = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
      entries.push(makeEntry(entriesPtrs + 88 * i));
    }
    return entries;
  }
  var desc = {
    "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
    "entries": makeEntries(HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (12)) >> 2)], HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (16)) >> 2)])
  };
  var device = WebGPU.getJsObject(devicePtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateBindGroupLayout(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, device.createBindGroupLayout(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuDeviceCreateTexture = (devicePtr, descriptor) => {
  var nextInChainPtr = HEAPU32[((descriptor) >> 2)];
  var textureBindingViewDimension;
  if (nextInChainPtr !== 0) {
    var sType = HEAP32[(((nextInChainPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
    var textureBindingViewDimensionDescriptor = nextInChainPtr;
    textureBindingViewDimension = WebGPU.TextureViewDimension[HEAP32[(((textureBindingViewDimensionDescriptor) + (8)) >> 2)]];
  }
  var desc = {
    "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
    "size": WebGPU.makeExtent3D(descriptor + 28),
    "mipLevelCount": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (44)) >> 2)],
    "sampleCount": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (48)) >> 2)],
    "dimension": WebGPU.TextureDimension[HEAP32[(((descriptor) + (24)) >> 2)]],
    "format": WebGPU.TextureFormat[HEAP32[(((descriptor) + (40)) >> 2)]],
    "usage": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (16)) >> 2)],
    "textureBindingViewDimension": textureBindingViewDimension
  };
  var viewFormatCount = HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (52)) >> 2)];
  if (viewFormatCount) {
    var viewFormatsPtr = HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (56)) >> 2)];
    // viewFormatsPtr pointer to an array of TextureFormat which is an enum of size uint32_t
    desc["viewFormats"] = Array.from(HEAP32.subarray((((viewFormatsPtr) >> 2)), ((viewFormatsPtr + viewFormatCount * 4) >> 2)), format => WebGPU.TextureFormat[format]);
  }
  var device = WebGPU.getJsObject(devicePtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateTexture(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, device.createTexture(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuQueueSubmit = (queuePtr, commandCount, commands) => {
  var queue = WebGPU.getJsObject(queuePtr);
  var cmds = Array.from(HEAP32.subarray((((commands) >> 2)), ((commands + commandCount * 4) >> 2)), id => WebGPU.getJsObject(id));
  queue.submit(cmds);
};

function _wgpuQueueWriteBuffer(queuePtr, bufferPtr, bufferOffset_low, bufferOffset_high, data, size) {
  var bufferOffset = convertI32PairToI53Checked(bufferOffset_low, bufferOffset_high);
  var queue = WebGPU.getJsObject(queuePtr);
  var buffer = WebGPU.getJsObject(bufferPtr);
  // There is a size limitation for ArrayBufferView. Work around by passing in a subarray
  // instead of the whole heap. crbug.com/1201109
  var subarray = HEAPU8.subarray(data, data + size);
  queue.writeBuffer(buffer, bufferOffset, subarray, 0, size);
}

var _wgpuQueueWriteTexture = (queuePtr, destinationPtr, data, dataSize, dataLayoutPtr, writeSizePtr) => {
  var queue = WebGPU.getJsObject(queuePtr);
  var destination = WebGPU.makeTexelCopyTextureInfo(destinationPtr);
  var dataLayout = WebGPU.makeTexelCopyBufferLayout(dataLayoutPtr);
  var writeSize = WebGPU.makeExtent3D(writeSizePtr);
  // This subarray isn't strictly necessary, but helps work around an issue
  // where Chromium makes a copy of the entire heap. crbug.com/1134457
  var subarray = HEAPU8.subarray(data, data + dataSize);
  queue.writeTexture(destination, subarray, dataLayout, writeSize);
};

var _wgpuTextureCreateView = (texturePtr, descriptor) => {
  var desc;
  if (descriptor) {
    var swizzle;
    var nextInChainPtr = HEAPU32[((descriptor) >> 2)];
    if (nextInChainPtr !== 0) {
      var sType = HEAP32[(((nextInChainPtr) + (4)) >> 2)];
      var swizzleDescriptor = nextInChainPtr;
      var swizzlePtr = swizzleDescriptor + 8;
      var r = WebGPU.ComponentSwizzle[HEAP32[((swizzlePtr) >> 2)]] || "r";
      var g = WebGPU.ComponentSwizzle[HEAP32[(((swizzlePtr) + (4)) >> 2)]] || "g";
      var b = WebGPU.ComponentSwizzle[HEAP32[(((swizzlePtr) + (8)) >> 2)]] || "b";
      var a = WebGPU.ComponentSwizzle[HEAP32[(((swizzlePtr) + (12)) >> 2)]] || "a";
      swizzle = `${r}${g}${b}${a}`;
    }
    var mipLevelCount = HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (24)) >> 2)];
    var arrayLayerCount = HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (32)) >> 2)];
    desc = {
      "label": WebGPU.makeStringFromOptionalStringView(descriptor + 4),
      "format": WebGPU.TextureFormat[HEAP32[(((descriptor) + (12)) >> 2)]],
      "dimension": WebGPU.TextureViewDimension[HEAP32[(((descriptor) + (16)) >> 2)]],
      "baseMipLevel": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (20)) >> 2)],
      "mipLevelCount": mipLevelCount === 4294967295 ? undefined : mipLevelCount,
      "baseArrayLayer": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (28)) >> 2)],
      "arrayLayerCount": arrayLayerCount === 4294967295 ? undefined : arrayLayerCount,
      "aspect": WebGPU.TextureAspect[HEAP32[(((descriptor) + (36)) >> 2)]],
      "usage": HEAPU32[(((descriptor) + (40)) >> 2)],
      "swizzle": swizzle
    };
  }
  var texture = WebGPU.getJsObject(texturePtr);
  var ptr = _emwgpuCreateTextureView(0);
  WebGPU.Internals.jsObjectInsert(ptr, texture.createView(desc));
  return ptr;
};

var _wgpuTextureDestroy = texturePtr => {
  WebGPU.getJsObject(texturePtr).destroy();
};

var _wgpuTextureGetFormat = texturePtr => {
  var texture = WebGPU.getJsObject(texturePtr);
  // Should return the enum integer instead of string.
  return WebGPU.TextureFormat.indexOf(texture.format);
};

  HEAP8.set(array, buffer);

/**
   * @param {string|null=} returnType
   * @param {Array=} argTypes
   * @param {Array=} args
   * @param {Object=} opts
   */ var ccall = (ident, returnType, argTypes, args, opts) => {
  // For fast lookup of conversion functions
  var toC = {
    "string": str => {
      var ret = 0;
      if (str !== null && str !== undefined && str !== 0) {
        // null string
        ret = stringToUTF8OnStack(str);
      }
      return ret;
    },
    "array": arr => {
      var ret = stackAlloc(arr.length);
      writeArrayToMemory(arr, ret);
      return ret;
    }
  };
  function convertReturnValue(ret) {
    if (returnType === "string") {
      return UTF8ToString(ret);
    }
    if (returnType === "boolean") return Boolean(ret);
    return ret;
  }
  var func = getCFunc(ident);
  var cArgs = [];
  var stack = 0;
  if (args) {
    for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
      var converter = toC[argTypes[i]];
      if (converter) {
        if (stack === 0) stack = stackSave();
        cArgs[i] = converter(args[i]);
      } else {
        cArgs[i] = args[i];
      }
    }
  }
  var ret = func(...cArgs);
  function onDone(ret) {
    if (stack !== 0) stackRestore(stack);
    return convertReturnValue(ret);
  }
  ret = onDone(ret);
  return ret;
};

function BeginGlQueryTiming(calc_name, num_repetitions) {
  const gl = Module.canvas.getContext("webgl2");
  const query = gl.createQuery();
  Module.WEBGL_SHADER_CALC_METRICS = Module.WEBGL_SHADER_CALC_METRICS || {};
  Module.WEBGL_SHADER_CALC_METRICS[UTF8ToString(calc_name)] = {
    query,
    repetitions: num_repetitions
  };
  Module.WEBGL_QUERY_TIMER_EXT = Module.WEBGL_QUERY_TIMER_EXT || gl.getExtension("EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2");
  gl.beginQuery(Module.WEBGL_QUERY_TIMER_EXT.TIME_ELAPSED_EXT, query);
}

function EndGlQueryTiming(calc_name) {
  const gl = Module.canvas.getContext("webgl2");
  gl.endQuery(Module.WEBGL_QUERY_TIMER_EXT.TIME_ELAPSED_EXT, Module.WEBGL_SHADER_CALC_METRICS[UTF8ToString(calc_name)].query);
}

function JsWrapImageConverter() {
  if (!Module._imageConverter) {
    Module._imageConverter = (binaryPtr, binarySize, width, height, numChannels, makeDeepCopy, outputType) => {
      const imageData = new outputType(makeDeepCopy ? Module.HEAPU8.slice(binaryPtr, binaryPtr + binarySize).buffer : Module.HEAPU8.buffer, binaryPtr, width * height * numChannels);
      return {
        data: imageData,
        width,
        height
      };
    };
  }
}

function JsWrapSimpleListeners() {
  if (!Module._wrapSimpleListenerOutput) {
    Module._wrapSimpleListenerOutput = (outputStreamName, ...args) => {
      if (Module.simpleListeners) {
        const streamName = UTF8ToString(outputStreamName);
        if (Module.simpleListeners[streamName]) {
          Module.simpleListeners[streamName](...args);
        }
      }
    };
  }
  if (!Module._wrapEmptyPacketListenerOutput) {
    Module._wrapEmptyPacketListenerOutput = (outputStreamName, timestamp) => {
      if (Module.emptyPacketListeners) {
        const streamName = UTF8ToString(outputStreamName);
        if (Module.emptyPacketListeners[streamName]) {
          Module.emptyPacketListeners[streamName](timestamp);
        }
      }
    };
  }
}

  Module._wrapSimpleListenerOutput(output_stream_name, newProtoArray, timestamp);
}

  if (typeof HTMLCanvasElement !== "undefined") {

  return Emval.toHandle(canvas);
}

function __asyncjs__mediapipe_map_buffer_jspi(buffer_handle, data) {
  return Asyncify.handleAsync(async () => {
    const buffer = WebGPU.getJsObject(buffer_handle);
    if ("mapSync" in buffer) {
      buffer.mapSync(GPUMapMode.READ);
    } else {
      await buffer.mapAsync(GPUMapMode.READ);
    }
    const mapped = buffer.getMappedRange();
    HEAPU8.set(new Uint8Array(mapped), data);
    buffer.unmap();
  });
}

function custom_emscripten_dbgn(str, len) {
  if (typeof (dbg) !== "undefined") {
    dbg(UTF8ToString(str, len));
  } else {
    if (typeof (custom_dbg) === "undefined") {
      function custom_dbg(text) {
        console.warn.apply(console, arguments);
      }
    }
    custom_dbg(UTF8ToString(str, len));
  }
}

function run() {
  if (runDependencies > 0) {
    dependenciesFulfilled = run;
    return;
  }
  preRun();
  // a preRun added a dependency, run will be called later
  if (runDependencies > 0) {
    dependenciesFulfilled = run;
    return;
  }
  function doRun() {
    // run may have just been called through dependencies being fulfilled just in this very frame,
    // or while the async setStatus time below was happening
    Module["calledRun"] = true;
    if (ABORT) return;
    initRuntime();
    readyPromiseResolve?.(Module);
    Module["onRuntimeInitialized"]?.();
    postRun();
  }
  if (Module["setStatus"]) {
    Module["setStatus"]("Running...");
    setTimeout(() => {
      setTimeout(() => Module["setStatus"](""), 1);
      doRun();
    }, 1);
  } else {
    doRun();
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Local dev proxy — same behavior as the Vercel function (api/youcam.mjs),
// run as a plain Node HTTP server for `npm run dev` without Vercel.
//
//   npm run proxy     (starts on http://localhost:8787)
//   npm run dev       (vite proxies /api → localhost:8787)
//
// Reads YOUCAM_API_KEY from .env (or the environment).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createTask, getUploadSlot, pollTask, putBytes, pickKey, youcamKeysFromEnv } from '../lib/youcamProxy.mjs';

// tiny .env loader (no deps)
if (existsSync('.env')) {
  for (const line of readFileSync('.env', 'utf-8').split('\n')) {
    const t = line.trim();
    if (!t || t.startsWith('#')) continue;
    const i = t.indexOf('=');
    if (i < 0) continue;
    const k = t.slice(0, i).trim();
    if (!process.env[k]) process.env[k] = t.slice(i + 1).trim();
  }
}

const PORT = Number(process.env.PROXY_PORT || 8787);
const keys = youcamKeysFromEnv(process.env);
const key = pickKey(keys);

const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'GET,POST,OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type');
  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
    res.writeHead(204).end();
    return;
  }

  const send = (status, json) => {
    res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
    res.end(JSON.stringify(json));
  };

  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  const action = url.searchParams.get('action');
  const slug = url.searchParams.get('slug') || '';

  if (action === 'health') {
    send(200, { configured: Boolean(key) });
    return;
  }
  if (!key) {
    send(401, { error: 'YOUCAM_API_KEY is not configured on the server' });
    return;
  }

  // read JSON body
  const chunks = [];
  for await (const c of req) chunks.push(c);
  let body = {};
  try {
    body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf-8') || '{}');
  } catch {
    send(400, { error: 'invalid JSON body' });
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (action === 'upload') {
      const buf = Buffer.from(body.dataBase64 || '', 'base64');
      if (buf.length === 0) throw new Error('empty payload');
      const slot = await getUploadSlot(key, slug, {
        contentType: body.contentType || 'image/jpeg',
        fileName: body.fileName || 'frame.jpg',
        fileSize: buf.length,
      });
      const up = slot.requests[0];
      await putBytes(up.url, up.method, up.headers, buf);
      send(200, { file_id: slot.file_id });
    } else if (action === 'task') {
      const taskId = await createTask(key, slug, body);
      send(200, { task_id: taskId });
    } else if (action === 'poll') {
      const taskId = url.searchParams.get('task_id') || '';
      const data = await pollTask(key, slug, taskId);
      send(200, data);
    } else {
      send(400, { error: 'unknown action' });
    }
  } catch (err) {
    send(err.status || 502, { error: err.message || String(err) });
  }
});

server.listen(PORT, '0.0.0.0', () => {
  console.log(`[youcam-proxy] listening on http://localhost:${PORT}`);
  console.log(`[youcam-proxy] API key: ${key ? 'configured' : 'NOT configured (health will say false)'}`);
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// LIVE verification against the real YouCam API with a real API key.
//   - probes unit-info endpoints
//   - uploads demo faces via the official File API
//   - runs skin-tone-analysis + skin-analysis (4 concerns), polls to done
//   - prints the FULL real response JSON so we can fix parsers if needed
//   - measures ACTUAL unit consumption (before/after)
// Usage: node scripts/live-test.mjs [facePath] [facePath2]
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

// load .env
const env = readFileSync(join(ROOT, '.env'), 'utf-8');
const KEY = (env.match(/YOUCAM_API_KEY=(.*)/)?.[1] ?? '').trim();
const BASE = 'https://yce-api-01.makeupar.com';
if (!KEY) {
  console.error('NO KEY in .env');
  process.exit(1);
}
const AUTH = { Authorization: `Bearer ${KEY}` };

const step = (s) => console.log(`\n=== ${s} ===`);
const log = (s) => console.log('  ' + s);

async function jfetch(url, init = {}) {
  const r = await fetch(url, init);
  const text = await r.text();
  let data;
  try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { data = { _raw: text.slice(0, 500) }; }
  return { status: r.status, ok: r.ok, data };
}

// ---- probe unit endpoints ----
async function probeUnits() {
  step('Probing unit-info endpoints');
  const paths = [
    '/s2s/v2.0/unit/info',
    '/s2s/v2.0/unit',
    '/s2s/v2.0/unit/history',
    '/s2s/v2.0/unit/feature-cost',
    '/s2s/v2.0/units/info',
  ];
  let found = null;
  for (const p of paths) {
    try {
      const { status, ok, data } = await jfetch(`${BASE}${p}`, { headers: AUTH });
      log(`GET ${p} → HTTP ${status}`);
      if (ok) {
        found = { path: p, data };
        log('   FOUND: ' + JSON.stringify(data).slice(0, 400));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      log(`GET ${p} → error ${e.message}`);
    }
  }
  return found;
}

// ---- upload ----
async function upload(filePath, slug) {
  step(`Upload ${filePath}${slug ? ` (slot: ${slug})` : ''}`);
  const buf = readFileSync(filePath);
  const contentType = filePath.endsWith('.png') ? 'image/png' : 'image/jpeg';
  const fileName = filePath.split('/').pop();

  // try official path first, then slug path
  let resp = null;
  for (const path of [`/s2s/v2.0/file${slug ? `/${slug}` : ''}`, `/s2s/v2.0/file/${slug}`]) {
    const r = await jfetch(`${BASE}${path}`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { ...AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ files: [{ content_type: contentType, file_name: fileName, file_size: buf.length }] }),
    });
    log(`POST ${path} → HTTP ${r.status}`);
    if (r.ok) { resp = r; break; }
    log('   ' + JSON.stringify(r.data).slice(0, 200));
  }
  if (!resp) throw new Error('upload slot failed on all paths');

  const file = resp.data.data.files[0];
  const up = file.requests[0];
  log(`file_id: ${file.file_id.slice(0, 30)}…`);
  const put = await fetch(up.url, { method: up.method || 'PUT', headers: up.headers, body: buf });
  log(`PUT bytes → HTTP ${put.status}`);
  if (!put.ok) throw new Error('S3 upload failed');
  return file.file_id;
}

// ---- task + poll ----
async function runTask(slug, body, timeoutMs = 180000) {
  step(`Task ${slug}`);
  const { status, ok, data } = await jfetch(`${BASE}/s2s/v2.0/task/${slug}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { ...AUTH, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  log(`POST task → HTTP ${status}`);
  if (!ok) { console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)); throw new Error('task create failed'); }
  const taskId = data.data?.task_id ?? data.result?.task_id ?? data.task_id;
  log(`task_id: ${taskId.slice(0, 30)}…`);

  const start = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
    const r = await jfetch(`${BASE}/s2s/v2.0/task/${slug}/${taskId}`, { headers: AUTH });
    const d = r.data?.data ?? r.data ?? r.data;
    const st = d?.task_status ?? d?.status;
    if (st === 'success') {
      log(`poll → success (${Math.round((Date.now() - start) / 1000)}s)`);
      return r.data;
    }
    if (st === 'error' || st === 'failed') {
      log('poll → ERROR');
      return r.data;
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500));
  }
  throw new Error('poll timeout');
}

// ---- main ----
const faces = process.argv.slice(2);
const targets = faces.length > 0 ? faces : [join(ROOT, 'public/demo/face-1.jpg')];

const unitProbe = await probeUnits();
let before = unitProbe?.data ?? null;

for (const face of targets) {
  log(`\n############ FACE: ${face} ############`);

  // skin-tone-analysis
  try {
    const fid = await upload(face, 'skin-tone-analysis');
    const res = await runTask('skin-tone-analysis', { src_file_id: fid, format: 'json' });
    console.log('\n--- REAL skin-tone-analysis response ---');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(res, null, 2).slice(0, 2500));
  } catch (e) { console.error('skin-tone failed:', e.message); }

  // skin-analysis (4 concerns)
  try {
    const fid = await upload(face, 'skin-analysis');
    const res = await runTask('skin-analysis', {
      src_file_id: fid,
      dst_actions: ['radiance', 'firmness', 'texture', 'pore'],
      format: 'json',
    });
    console.log('\n--- REAL skin-analysis response ---');
    console.log(JSON.stringify(res, null, 2).slice(0, 4000));
  } catch (e) { console.error('skin-analysis failed:', e.message); }
}

// units after
if (unitProbe) {
  step('Units after');
  const { data } = await jfetch(`${BASE}${unitProbe.path}`, { headers: AUTH });
  console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2).slice(0, 1500));
}
console.log('\nDONE');

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Vendor local runtime assets so the app works fully offline / in sandboxed
// previews (no CDN dependency):
//   1. Copies @mediapipe/tasks-vision WASM loaders into public/vendor/wasm
//   2. Downloads the face_landmarker model into public/models (if missing)
// Runs automatically via `postinstall`; safe to re-run anytime.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const root = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) + '/..';
const wasmSrc = join(root, 'node_modules', '@mediapipe', 'tasks-vision', 'wasm');
const wasmDest = join(root, 'public', 'vendor', 'wasm');
const modelUrl =
  'https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/face_landmarker/face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task';
const modelDest = join(root, 'public', 'models', 'face_landmarker.task');

mkdirSync(wasmDest, { recursive: true });
mkdirSync(dirname(modelDest), { recursive: true });

// 1) WASM files
let copied = 0;
for (const file of readdirSync(wasmSrc)) {
  const src = join(wasmSrc, file);
  if (!statSync(src).isFile()) continue;
  copyFileSync(src, join(wasmDest, file));
  copied++;
}
console.log(`[vendor] copied ${copied} Mediapipe WASM files -> public/vendor/wasm`);

// 2) Model
if (existsSync(modelDest) && statSync(modelDest).size > 1_000_000) {
  console.log('[vendor] face_landmarker.task already present');
} else {
  console.log('[vendor] downloading face_landmarker.task (~3.7 MB)...');
  const res = await fetch(modelUrl);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`model download failed: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  await import('node:fs/promises').then((f) => f.writeFile(modelDest, buf));
  console.log(`[vendor] saved ${(buf.length / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB -> public/models/face_landmarker.task`);
}

type Screen = 'home' | 'live' | 'demo';

export default function App() {
  const [screen, setScreen] = useState<Screen>('home');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shareOpen, setShareOpen] = useState(false);

  const start = useCallback((mode: LiveMode) => {
    setError(null);
    useStore.getState().reset();
    setScreen(mode);
  }, []);

  const goHome = useCallback(() => setScreen('home'), []);

  const handleError = useCallback((message: string) => setError(message), []);

  const share = useCallback(async () => {
    const { beautyScore, emotion } = useStore.getState();
    const text = `My Live-Beauty-Score: ${beautyScore}/100 · feeling ${emotion} ✨`;
    try {
      if (navigator.share) {
        await navigator.share({ title: 'Live-Beauty-Score', text, url: location.href });
      } else {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`${text} — ${location.href}`);
        setShareOpen(true);
      }
    } catch {
      /* user cancelled */
    }
  }, []);

  const running = screen !== 'home';

  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
      <CssBaseline />

      {/* cream translucent header */}
      <Box
        component="header"
        sx={{
          position: 'sticky',
          top: 0,
          zIndex: 1200,
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(160%)',
          WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(20px) saturate(160%)',
          background: 'rgba(250,249,245,0.82)',
          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--hairline)',
        }}
      >
        <Box sx={{ maxWidth: 900, mx: 'auto', px: { xs: 2, sm: 3 }, height: 56, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 1.5 }}>
          <img src={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}assets/logo.svg`} alt="" style={{ height: 30, width: 30 }} />
          <Typography sx={{ flexGrow: 1, fontWeight: 600, fontSize: 17, letterSpacing: '-0.01em', color: 'var(--ink)' }}>
            Live‑Beauty‑Score
          </Typography>
          {running && (
            <>
              <button type="button" className="btn-secondary pressable" style={{ padding: '7px 14px', fontSize: 13 }} onClick={goHome}>
                <ArrowBackIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> Back
              </button>
              <button type="button" className="btn-primary pressable" style={{ padding: '7px 14px', fontSize: 13 }} onClick={share}>
                <ShareIcon sx={{ fontSize: 14 }} /> Share
              </button>
            </>
          )}
        </Box>
      </Box>

      <Container maxWidth="md" sx={{ py: { xs: 2, sm: 4 }, px: { xs: 1.5, sm: 3 } }}>
        {screen === 'home' ? (
          <StartScreen onStart={start} />
        ) : (
          <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2.2 }} className="animate-materialize">
            <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center', px: 2 }}>
              <Typography variant="h5" gutterBottom sx={{ mb: 0.5 }}>
                {screen === 'live' ? 'Live AR mirror' : 'Demo reel'}
              </Typography>
              <Typography variant="body2" sx={{ color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                {screen === 'live'
                  ? 'Smile for confetti, frown and it rains — your score updates in real time.'
                  : 'Sample faces run through the full pipeline — no camera needed.'}
              </Typography>
            </Box>

            <FaceMeshComponent mode={screen} onError={handleError} />

            <FilterPicker />
            <CloudPanel />
            <AIStudioPanel />
          </Box>
        )}
      </Container>

      {/* dark footer band — closes the page with product chrome */}
      <Box component="footer" sx={{ textAlign: 'center', py: 4, mt: 4, background: '#181715', color: 'rgba(160,157,150,0.9)' }}>
        <Typography variant="caption">
          Built for the YouCam API Hackathon · React + TypeScript + Mediapipe ·{' '}
          <FooterStatus />
        </Typography>
      </Box>

      <Snackbar
        open={shareOpen}
        autoHideDuration={3000}
        onClose={() => setShareOpen(false)}
        message="Link + score copied to clipboard ✨"
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'center' }}
      />
      <Snackbar
        open={Boolean(error)}
        autoHideDuration={8000}
        onClose={() => setError(null)}
        anchorOrigin={{ vertical: 'bottom', horizontal: 'center' }}
      >
        <Alert severity="warning" variant="filled" onClose={() => setError(null)} action={
          <Button color="inherit" size="small" onClick={() => start('demo')}>
            Try demo reel
          </Button>
        }>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      </Snackbar>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

/** Footer status: reflects the backend health probe result. */
function FooterStatus() {
  const { apiConfigured, cloudEnabled, unitsUsed } = useStore();
  if (!apiConfigured) return <span>On-device AI mode (add <strong>YOUCAM_API_KEY</strong> on the server to enable YouCam Cloud)</span>;
  if (cloudEnabled) return <span>YouCam Cloud mode · ~{unitsUsed} units used</span>;
  return <span>YouCam Cloud ready — enable it in the panel below the camera</span>;
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { EmotionLabel } from './types/youcam';

export interface FilterConfig {
  /** lip tint hex color */
  lipColor: string;
  /** 0..1 lip tint opacity */
  lipOpacity: number;
  eyeshadow: boolean;
  blush: boolean;
  glow: boolean;
  particles: boolean;
}

export const DEFAULT_FILTER: FilterConfig = {
  lipColor: '#e11d48',
  lipOpacity: 0.72,
  eyeshadow: true,
  blush: true,
  glow: true,
  particles: true,
};

export type ApiMode = 'youcam' | 'ondevice';
export type DemoMode = 'live' | 'demo';
export type CloudCadence = 'manual' | '2m' | '10m';

interface AppState {
  // ---- live metrics (driven by the vision pipeline) ----
  beautyScore: number;
  emotion: EmotionLabel;
  emotionConfidence: number;
  skinTone: string | null;
  /** YouCam "glow" score (skin-analysis ui_score blend), when available */
  glowScore: number | null;
  /** AI-derived skin age from YouCam skin-analysis, when available */
  skinAge: number | null;
  /** mode that produced the last score */
  apiMode: ApiMode;
  /** false when the last API call failed (YouCam mode only) */
  apiHealthy: boolean;
  /** last cloud error message (shown in UI, e.g. credits exhausted) */
  apiError: string | null;
  fps: number;
  lastUpdate: number | null;

  // ---- YouCam cloud controls ----
  /** true once the backend reports an API key is configured */
  apiConfigured: boolean;
  cloudEnabled: boolean;
  cadence: CloudCadence;
  /** estimated units spent (1 per successful task on the free tier) */
  unitsUsed: number;

  // ---- user preferences ----
  filter: FilterConfig;
  showMesh: boolean;
  /** bumped to force an immediate re-score */
  reScoreTick: number;
  /** bumped to force an immediate tones analysis (skin-tone-analysis) */
  tonesTick: number;

  // ---- actions ----
  setBeautyScore: (v: number) => void;
  setEmotion: (e: EmotionLabel, confidence: number) => void;
  setSkinTone: (hex: string | null) => void;
  setGlowScore: (v: number | null) => void;
  setSkinAge: (v: number | null) => void;
  setApiMode: (m: ApiMode, healthy: boolean) => void;
  setApiError: (msg: string | null) => void;
  setFps: (fps: number) => void;
  setLastUpdate: (ts: number) => void;
  setApiConfigured: (ok: boolean) => void;
  setCloudEnabled: (on: boolean) => void;
  setCadence: (c: CloudCadence) => void;
  addUnits: (n: number) => void;
  setFilter: (patch: Partial<FilterConfig>) => void;
  toggleMesh: () => void;
  requestReScore: () => void;
  requestTones: () => void;
  reset: () => void;
}

export const useStore = create<AppState>((set) => ({
  beautyScore: 0,
  emotion: 'neutral',
  emotionConfidence: 0,
  skinTone: null,
  glowScore: null,
  skinAge: null,
  apiMode: 'ondevice',
  apiHealthy: true,
  apiError: null,
  fps: 0,
  lastUpdate: null,

  apiConfigured: false,
  cloudEnabled: false,
  cadence: 'manual',
  unitsUsed: 0,

  filter: DEFAULT_FILTER,
  showMesh: false,
  reScoreTick: 0,
  tonesTick: 0,

  setBeautyScore: (v) => set({ beautyScore: v }),
  setEmotion: (e, confidence) => set({ emotion: e, emotionConfidence: confidence }),
  setSkinTone: (hex) => set({ skinTone: hex }),
  setGlowScore: (v) => set({ glowScore: v }),
  setSkinAge: (v) => set({ skinAge: v }),
  setApiMode: (m, healthy) => set({ apiMode: m, apiHealthy: healthy }),
  setApiError: (msg) => set({ apiError: msg }),
  setFps: (fps) => set({ fps }),
  setLastUpdate: (ts) => set({ lastUpdate: ts }),
  setApiConfigured: (ok) => set({ apiConfigured: ok }),
  setCloudEnabled: (on) => set({ cloudEnabled: on }),
  setCadence: (c) => set({ cadence: c }),
  addUnits: (n) => set((s) => ({ unitsUsed: s.unitsUsed + n })),
  setFilter: (patch) => set((s) => ({ filter: { ...s.filter, ...patch } })),
  toggleMesh: () => set((s) => ({ showMesh: !s.showMesh })),
  requestReScore: () => set((s) => ({ reScoreTick: s.reScoreTick + 1 })),
  requestTones: () => set((s) => ({ tonesTick: s.tonesTick + 1 })),
  reset: () =>
    set({
      beautyScore: 0,
      emotion: 'neutral',
      emotionConfidence: 0,
      skinTone: null,
      glowScore: null,
      skinAge: null,
      apiMode: 'ondevice',
      apiHealthy: true,
      apiError: null,
      fps: 0,
      lastUpdate: null,
      apiConfigured: false,
      cloudEnabled: false,
      cadence: 'manual',
      unitsUsed: 0,
      filter: DEFAULT_FILTER,
      showMesh: false,
      reScoreTick: 0,
      tonesTick: 0,
    }),
}));

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  classifyEmotion,
  computeBeautyScore,
  hexLuminance,
  IDX,
  sampleSkinTone,
} from '../utils/beauty';
import type { Point } from '../utils/beauty';

/** Builds a plausible frontal-face landmark set from a 2D grid of points. */
function syntheticFace(overrides: Record<number, Partial<Point>> = {}): Point[] {
  const pts: Point[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 478; i++) {
    // spread landmarks across a normalized face-ish region
    pts.push({ x: 0.3 + ((i * 37) % 100) / 250, y: 0.3 + ((i * 53) % 100) / 250, z: 0 });
  }
  // impose real topology anchors
  const set = (i: number, x: number, y: number) => (pts[i] = { x, y, z: 0 });
  set(IDX.noseBridge, 0.5, 0.42);
  set(IDX.noseTip, 0.5, 0.5);
  set(IDX.chin, 0.5, 0.85);
  set(IDX.forehead, 0.5, 0.18);
  set(IDX.leftCheek, 0.35, 0.55);
  set(IDX.rightCheek, 0.65, 0.55);
  set(IDX.leftEyeOuter, 0.4, 0.44);
  set(IDX.leftEyeInner, 0.47, 0.44);
  set(IDX.rightEyeOuter, 0.6, 0.44);
  set(IDX.rightEyeInner, 0.53, 0.44);
  set(IDX.leftBrowMid, 0.42, 0.38);
  set(IDX.rightBrowMid, 0.58, 0.38);
  set(IDX.mouthLeft, 0.44, 0.68);
  set(IDX.mouthRight, 0.56, 0.68);
  set(IDX.mouthTop, 0.5, 0.655);
  set(IDX.mouthBottom, 0.5, 0.71);
  set(0, 0.5, 0.66);
  set(13, 0.5, 0.665);
  set(14, 0.5, 0.7);
  set(17, 0.5, 0.705);
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(overrides)) {
    const i = Number(k);
    pts[i] = { ...pts[i], ...v };
  }
  return pts;
}

const blends = (map: Record<string, number>) =>
  Object.entries(map).map(([categoryName, score]) => ({ categoryName, score }));

describe('classifyEmotion (blendshapes)', () => {
  it('detects happy from mouthSmile', () => {
    const r = classifyEmotion(blends({ mouthSmileLeft: 0.8, mouthSmileRight: 0.75 }));
    expect(r.emotion).toBe('happy');
    expect(r.confidence).toBeGreaterThan(0.8);
  });

  it('detects surprised from jawOpen + brow raise', () => {
    const r = classifyEmotion(blends({ jawOpen: 0.6, browInnerUp: 0.5 }));
    expect(r.emotion).toBe('surprised');
  });

  it('detects sad from mouthFrown', () => {
    const r = classifyEmotion(blends({ mouthFrownLeft: 0.55, mouthFrownRight: 0.5 }));
    expect(r.emotion).toBe('sad');
  });

  it('falls back to neutral for flat blendshapes', () => {
    const r = classifyEmotion(blends({}));
    expect(r.emotion).toBe('neutral');
  });

  it('falls back to geometry when blendshapes are missing', () => {
    const wide = syntheticFace({ [IDX.mouthBottom]: { y: 0.76 } });
    const r = classifyEmotion(null, wide);
    expect(['surprised', 'happy', 'neutral']).toContain(r.emotion);
  });
});

describe('computeBeautyScore', () => {
  it('returns a score within 55–99 for a synthetic face', () => {
    const face = syntheticFace();
    const score = computeBeautyScore(face);
    expect(score).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(55);
    expect(score).toBeLessThanOrEqual(99);
  });

  it('returns last score when landmarks are insufficient', () => {
    expect(computeBeautyScore([], 71)).toBe(71);
    expect(computeBeautyScore([])).toBe(0);
  });

  it('penalizes strong asymmetry', () => {
    const symmetric = computeBeautyScore(syntheticFace());
    const asymmetric = computeBeautyScore(
      syntheticFace({ [IDX.leftCheek]: { x: 0.18 }, [IDX.leftEyeOuter]: { x: 0.24 } })
    );
    expect(asymmetric).toBeLessThanOrEqual(symmetric);
  });

  it('smooths toward the previous value', () => {
    const face = syntheticFace();
    const a = computeBeautyScore(face);
    const b = computeBeautyScore(face, a);
    expect(Math.abs(b - a)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(25);
  });
});

describe('skin tone', () => {
  it('returns null when landmarks are missing', () => {
    expect(sampleSkinTone({} as CanvasImageSource, [], 100, 100)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('parses luminance from hex', () => {
    expect(hexLuminance('#ffffff')).toBeGreaterThan(hexLuminance('#000000'));
    expect(hexLuminance('garbage')).toBe(128);
  });
});

    expect(useStore.getState().emotionConfidence).toBeCloseTo(0.92);
  });

    const { setBeautyScore } = useStore.getState();
    setBeautyScore(-5);
    expect(useStore.getState().beautyScore).toBe(-5); // raw setter; UI clamps
    setBeautyScore(72);
    expect(useStore.getState().beautyScore).toBe(72);
  });

  it('applies filter patches without clobbering other keys', () => {
    const { setFilter } = useStore.getState();
    setFilter({ lipColor: '#f472b6' });
    const f = useStore.getState().filter;
    expect(f.lipColor).toBe('#f472b6');
    expect(f.particles).toBe(true);
    expect(f.lipOpacity).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('bumps reScoreTick on requestReScore', () => {
    const before = useStore.getState().reScoreTick;
    useStore.getState().requestReScore();
    expect(useStore.getState().reScoreTick).toBe(before + 1);
  });

  it('tracks cloud state and units', () => {
    const s = useStore.getState();
    s.setApiConfigured(true);
    s.setCloudEnabled(true);
    s.setCadence('2m');
    s.addUnits(2);
    expect(useStore.getState().apiConfigured).toBe(true);
    expect(useStore.getState().cloudEnabled).toBe(true);
    expect(useStore.getState().cadence).toBe('2m');

  });

    expect(useStore.getState().glowScore).toBe(81);
  });
});

  status: 200,

      output: [
        { ui_score: 62, mask_urls: ['https://…pore.png'], raw_score: 37.997, type: 'pore', url: null },
        { ui_score: 81, mask_urls: ['https://…radiance.png'], raw_score: 81.067, type: 'radiance', url: null },

        { score: 76.25, type: 'all', url: null },
        { score: 38, type: 'skin_age', url: null },
        { mask_urls: ['https://…resize.jpg'], type: 'resize_image', url: null },
      ],
    },
    task_status: 'success',
  },
};

describe('parseSkinToneResult (real response)', () => {
  it('extracts skin_color hex', () => {
    const r = parseSkinToneResult(REAL_TONE);
    expect(r.skinToneHex).toBe('#997152');
  });

  it('collects all color hexes keyed by field name', () => {
    const r = parseSkinToneResult(REAL_TONE);
    expect(r.colors.skin_color).toBe('#997152');
    expect(r.colors.eye_color).toBe('#241711');
    expect(r.colors.lip_color).toBe('#CC7F71');
  });

  it('keeps human-readable names', () => {
    const r = parseSkinToneResult(REAL_TONE);
    expect(r.names.eye_color_name).toBe('Brown');
  });

  it('returns null tone when nothing matches', () => {
    expect(parseSkinToneResult({ foo: 42 }).skinToneHex).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('parseSkinAnalysisResult (real response)', () => {
  it('maps output[] type → ui_score', () => {
    const r = parseSkinAnalysisResult(REAL_SKIN);
    expect(r.scores.pore).toBe(62);
    expect(r.scores.texture).toBe(84);
    expect(r.scores.firmness).toBe(78);
    expect(r.scores.radiance).toBe(81);
  });

  it('keeps items with mask URLs', () => {
    const r = parseSkinAnalysisResult(REAL_SKIN);
    expect(r.items).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(r.items[0].type).toBe('pore');
    expect(r.items[0].maskUrls[0]).toContain('https://');
    expect(r.items[0].rawScore).toBeCloseTo(37.997);
  });

  it('extracts the overall "all" score and skin age', () => {
    const r = parseSkinAnalysisResult(REAL_SKIN);
    expect(r.all).toBeCloseTo(76.25);
    expect(r.skinAge).toBe(38);
    // resize_image is not a concern
    expect(r.scores.resize_image).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('computes glow from the overall "all" score when present', () => {
    const glow = glowFromSkinAnalysis(parseSkinAnalysisResult(REAL_SKIN));
    expect(glow).toBe(76);
  });

  it('handles error responses gracefully', () => {
    const r = parseSkinAnalysisResult({ status: 200, data: { error: 'error_src_face_too_small', results: null, task_status: 'error' } });
    expect(r.scores).toEqual({});
    expect(r.all).toBeNull();
    expect(glowFromSkinAnalysis(r)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('handles garbage gracefully', () => {
    const r = parseSkinAnalysisResult(null);
    expect(r.all).toBeNull();
    expect(Object.keys(r.scores)).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

describe('cadenceToMs', () => {
  it('maps cadences', () => {
    expect(cadenceToMs('2m')).toBe(120_000);
    expect(cadenceToMs('10m')).toBe(600_000);
    expect(cadenceToMs('manual')).toBeNull();
  });
});

interface ModalState {

  makeupUrl?: string | null;
  frames?: AgingFrame[];
  fitz?: string | null;
  report?: SkinAnalysisResult;

const FITZ_INFO: Record<string, { name: string; note: string }> = {
  I: { name: 'White', note: 'Almost always burns, never tans' },
  II: { name: 'Beige', note: 'Usually burns, tans minimally' },
  III: { name: 'Light Brown', note: 'Sometimes burns, gradually tans' },
  IV: { name: 'Medium Brown', note: 'Rarely burns, tans easily' },
  V: { name: 'Dark Brown', note: 'Very rarely burns' },
  VI: { name: 'Very Dark Brown', note: 'Almost never burns' },
};

const scoreColor = (s: number) => (s >= 80 ? '#4ade80' : s >= 60 ? '#fbbf24' : '#fb7185');

export const AIStudioPanel: React.FC = () => {
  const { filter, apiConfigured, addUnits } = useStore();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<BusyKind>(null);
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalState | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sliderPos, setSliderPos] = useState(50);
  const [activeMask, setActiveMask] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const run = useCallback(
    async (kind: Exclude<BusyKind, null>, fn: () => Promise<ModalState>) => {
      const snap = getFrameSnap();
      if (!snap || snap.pts.length < 468) {
        setError('No face detected yet — look at the camera first.');
        return;
      }
      setBusy(kind);
      setError(null);
      try {
        const res = await fn();
        setModal(res);
      } catch (e) {
        setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e));
      } finally {
        setBusy(null);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const doMakeup = useCallback(() => {
    void run('makeup', async () => {
      const snap = getFrameSnap()!;
      const blob = await captureFaceJpeg(snap.source, snap.pts, snap.w, snap.h, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
      const res = await youcamMakeupVto(blob, buildMakeupEffects(filter));
      addUnits(UNIT_COST['makeup-vto'] ?? 1);
      return { kind: 'makeup', makeupUrl: res.imageUrl };
    });
  }, [run, filter, addUnits]);

  const doAging = useCallback(() => {
    void run('aging', async () => {
      const snap = getFrameSnap()!;
      const blob = await captureFaceJpeg(snap.source, snap.pts, snap.w, snap.h, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
      const res = await youcamAging(blob);
      addUnits(UNIT_COST.aging ?? 2);
      return { kind: 'aging', frames: res.frames };
    });
  }, [run, addUnits]);

  const doFitz = useCallback(() => {
    void run('fitz', async () => {
      const snap = getFrameSnap()!;
      const blob = await captureFaceJpeg(snap.source, snap.pts, snap.w, snap.h, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
      const res = await youcamFitzpatrick(blob);
      addUnits(UNIT_COST.fitzpatrick ?? 10);
      return { kind: 'fitz', fitz: res.scale };
    });
  }, [run, addUnits]);

  const doReport = useCallback(() => {
    void run('report', async () => {
      const snap = getFrameSnap()!;
      const blob = await captureFaceJpeg(snap.source, snap.pts, snap.w, snap.h, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
      const res = await youcamFullSkinReport(blob);
      addUnits(UNIT_COST['skin-analysis-full'] ?? 16);
      return { kind: 'report', report: res };
    });
  }, [run, addUnits]);

  const canRun = apiConfigured;
  const report = modal?.kind === 'report' ? modal.report : undefined;

  const buttonSx = {
    borderRadius: 999,
    color: 'var(--on-dark)',
    borderColor: 'rgba(250,249,245,0.18)',
    background: 'var(--dark-elevated)',
    textTransform: 'none',
    fontWeight: 600,
    letterSpacing: '-0.005em',
    '&:hover': { background: 'rgba(250,249,245,0.12)', borderColor: 'rgba(250,249,245,0.3)' },
    '&:active': { transform: 'scale(0.97)' },
  };

  return (
    <Paper
      elevation={0}
      className="dark-panel"
      sx={{ p: 2.2, borderRadius: 16, background: 'var(--dark)' }}
    >
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between', flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: 1 }}>
        <Typography variant="overline" sx={{ color: 'rgba(160,157,150,0.85)', fontSize: 10.5 }}>
          AI Studio — real YouCam transformations
        </Typography>
        <Chip
          size="small"
          label={canRun ? 'Cloud ready' : 'Enable API key'}
          color={canRun ? 'success' : 'default'}
          variant="outlined"
        />
      </Box>

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 1, mt: 1.5, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
        <Button size="small" variant="outlined" startIcon={<BrushIcon />} disabled={!canRun || busy !== null} onClick={doMakeup} sx={buttonSx}>
          {busy === 'makeup' ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : '💄 AI Makeup'}
          <Box component="span" sx={{ ml: 0.6, opacity: 0.6 }}>1u</Box>
        </Button>
        <Button size="small" variant="outlined" startIcon={<FaceIcon />} disabled={!canRun || busy !== null} onClick={doAging} sx={buttonSx}>
          {busy === 'aging' ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : '🧓 Time Machine'}
          <Box component="span" sx={{ ml: 0.6, opacity: 0.6 }}>2u</Box>
        </Button>
        <Button size="small" variant="outlined" startIcon={<BiotechIcon />} disabled={!canRun || busy !== null} onClick={doFitz} sx={buttonSx}>
          {busy === 'fitz' ? <CircularProgress size={14} color="inherit" /> : '🧬 Skin Type'}
          <Box component="span" sx={{ ml: 0.6, opacity: 0.6 }}>10u</Box>

                    <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)' }}>Skin Age</Typography>
                  </Box>
                )}
                <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.45)', maxWidth: 320 }}>
                  Higher = healthier. Tap a concern to toggle its detection mask.
                </Typography>
              </Box>
              <Grid container spacing={1}>
                {Object.entries(report.scores).map(([type, score]) => {
                  const item = report.items.find((i) => i.type === type);
                  const maskUrl = item?.maskUrls?.[0];
                  return (
                    <Grid key={type} item xs={6} sm={4} md={3}>
                      <Box
                        onClick={() => maskUrl && setActiveMask(activeMask === maskUrl ? null : maskUrl)}
                        sx={{
                          borderRadius: 2,
                          p: 1.2,
                          border: `1px solid ${activeMask === maskUrl ? '#ec4899' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)'}`,
                          cursor: maskUrl ? 'pointer' : 'default',
                          background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)',
                          '&:hover': maskUrl ? { borderColor: '#ec4899' } : {},
                        }}
                      >
                        <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)', display: 'block' }}>
                          {CONCERN_LABELS[type] ?? type}
                        </Typography>
                        <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ fontWeight: 800, color: scoreColor(score) }}>
                          {Math.round(score)}
                        </Typography>
                      </Box>
                    </Grid>
                  );
                })}
              </Grid>
              {activeMask && (
                <Box sx={{ mt: 2, borderRadius: 2, overflow: 'hidden', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)' }}>
                  <img src={activeMask} alt="Detection mask" style={{ width: '100%', display: 'block' }} />
                  <Typography variant="caption" sx={{ display: 'block', textAlign: 'center', py: 0.6, color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)' }}>
                    YouCam detection mask — tap again to hide
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </Box>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </Paper>
  );
};

FILE: src/components/FaceMesh.tsx  (24,555 bytes)
