import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Box, Chip, CircularProgress, IconButton, Paper, Tooltip, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import ReplayIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Replay';
import CameraswitchIcon from '@mui/icons-material/Cameraswitch';
import AutoAwesomeIcon from '@mui/icons-material/AutoAwesome';
import FaceRetouchingOffIcon from '@mui/icons-material/FaceRetouchingOff';
import type {
  FaceLandmarker as FaceLandmarkerType,
  FaceLandmarkerResult,
} from '@mediapipe/tasks-vision';

import { useStore } from '../store';
import { OverlayRenderer } from '../utils/canvasOverlay';
import { classifyEmotion, computeBeautyScore, sampleSkinTone, type Point } from '../utils/beauty';
import {
  apiHealth,
  captureFaceJpeg,
  youcamSkinAnalysis,
  youcamSkinToneAnalysis,
  UNIT_COST,
  unitsRemaining,
  MIN_UNITS_BUFFER,
  SNAPSHOT_W,
  SNAPSHOT_H,
} from '../utils/youcam';
import { glowFromSkinAnalysis } from '../utils/youcamParsers';
import { cadenceToMs } from '../utils/youcamParsers';
import { setFrameSnap } from '../utils/frameBus';
import type { EmotionLabel } from '../types/youcam';
import { ScoreGauge } from './ScoreGauge';
import { EmotionBadge } from './EmotionBadge';

export type LiveMode = 'live' | 'demo';

interface Props {
  mode: LiveMode;
  onError: (message: string) => void;
}

const CANVAS_W = 640;
const CANVAS_H = 480;
const DEMO_IMAGE_MS = 5200;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Lazily-created Mediapipe landmarkers (cached across mounts).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type LandmarkerKind = 'VIDEO' | 'IMAGE';

const landmarkers = new Map<LandmarkerKind, Promise<FaceLandmarkerType>>();

function getLandmarker(kind: LandmarkerKind): Promise<FaceLandmarkerType> {
  const existing = landmarkers.get(kind);
  if (existing) return existing;

  const promise = (async () => {
    const { FaceLandmarker, FilesetResolver } = await import('@mediapipe/tasks-vision');
    const vision = await FilesetResolver.forVisionTasks(`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}vendor/wasm`);
    const options = {
      baseOptions: { modelAssetPath: '/models/face_landmarker.task' },
      runningMode: kind,
      numFaces: 1,
      outputFaceBlendshapes: true,
      outputFacialTransformationMatrixes: false,
    };
    // Prefer GPU (WebGL); fall back to CPU on machines/iframes without WebGL.
    try {
      return await FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
        ...options,
        baseOptions: { ...options.baseOptions, delegate: 'GPU' },
      });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('GPU delegate unavailable, falling back to CPU', err);
      return FaceLandmarker.createFromOptions(vision, {
        ...options,
        baseOptions: { ...options.baseOptions, delegate: 'CPU' },
      });
    }
  })();

  landmarkers.set(kind, promise);
  return promise;
}

const DEMO_FACES = [
  `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}demo/face-1.jpg`,
  `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}demo/face-2.jpg`,
  `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}demo/face-3.jpg`,
];

function preloadImage(src: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Failed to load ${src}`));
    img.src = src;
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export const FaceMeshComponent: React.FC<Props> = ({ mode, onError }) => {
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const rendererRef = useRef<OverlayRenderer | null>(null);
  const rafRef = useRef(0);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const stopRef = useRef(false);
  /** increments per start; stale async continuations bail out (StrictMode / remounts) */
  const runIdRef = useRef(0);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState<'loading' | 'running' | 'failed'>('loading');
  const [demoIndex, setDemoIndex] = useState(0);

  // scoring state
  const lastReScoreTick = useRef(useStore.getState().reScoreTick);
  const lastEmotionRef = useRef<EmotionLabel>('neutral');
  const cloudBusyRef = useRef(false);
  const lastCloudAtRef = useRef(0);
  const tonesDoneRef = useRef(false);
  const lastTonesTickRef = useRef(useStore.getState().tonesTick);

  const setFps = useStore((s) => s.setFps);
  const setApiMode = useStore((s) => s.setApiMode);
  const setApiError = useStore((s) => s.setApiError);
  const setApiConfigured = useStore((s) => s.setApiConfigured);
  const setBeautyScore = useStore((s) => s.setBeautyScore);
  const setEmotion = useStore((s) => s.setEmotion);
  const setSkinTone = useStore((s) => s.setSkinTone);
  const setGlowScore = useStore((s) => s.setGlowScore);
  const setSkinAge = useStore((s) => s.setSkinAge);
  const setLastUpdate = useStore((s) => s.setLastUpdate);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // YouCam cloud scoring (unit-gated, costs verified live):
  //   Glow (skin-analysis, 4 concerns) → 9 units per success
  //   Tones (skin-tone-analysis)       → 20 units per success
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  /** True when the face is too small for cloud analysis (snapshots are
   * face-cropped, so anything beyond a tiny detection is sendable — failed
   * tasks cost 0 units anyway). */
  const faceTooSmall = (landmarks: Point[], srcW: number): boolean => {
    if (!landmarks || landmarks.length < 468) return true;
    const l = landmarks[234];
    const r = landmarks[454];
    return Math.abs(r.x - l.x) * srcW < srcW * 0.12;
  };

  const runCloudGlow = useCallback(
    async (source: CanvasImageSource, pts: Point[], srcW: number, srcH: number) => {
    const snapshot = await captureFaceJpeg(source, pts, srcW, srcH, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
    const skin = await youcamSkinAnalysis(snapshot);
    useStore.getState().addUnits(UNIT_COST['skin-analysis'] ?? 9);
    setSkinAge(skin.skinAge);
    return glowFromSkinAnalysis(skin);
  }, [setSkinAge]);

  const runCloudTones = useCallback(
    async (source: CanvasImageSource, pts: Point[], srcW: number, srcH: number) => {
    const snapshot = await captureFaceJpeg(source, pts, srcW, srcH, SNAPSHOT_W, SNAPSHOT_H);
    const tones = await youcamSkinToneAnalysis(snapshot);
    useStore.getState().addUnits(UNIT_COST['skin-tone-analysis'] ?? 20);
    return tones;
  }, []);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Scoring: on-device runs ALWAYS (free). YouCam cloud runs on top when
  // enabled — the final beauty score blends geometry (60%) + glow (40%).
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const runScore = useCallback(
    async (source: CanvasImageSource, srcW: number, srcH: number, landmarks?: Point[], blendshapes?: FaceLandmarkerResult['faceBlendshapes']) => {
      const now = performance.now();
      const s0 = useStore.getState();

      // ---- on-device (always, free, instant) ----
      const pts = landmarks ?? [];
      const bsList =
        blendshapes?.[0]?.categories.map((c) => ({ categoryName: c.categoryName, score: c.score })) ??
        [];
      const { emotion, confidence } = classifyEmotion(bsList, pts);
      const geo = computeBeautyScore(pts, s0.beautyScore);
      if (confidence > 0.35 || emotion !== lastEmotionRef.current) {
        setEmotion(emotion, confidence);
        lastEmotionRef.current = emotion;
      }
      const tone = sampleSkinTone(source, pts, srcW, srcH);
      if (tone) setSkinTone(tone);
      setBeautyScore(geo);

      // ---- cloud (optional, unit-gated) ----
      const force = s0.reScoreTick !== lastReScoreTick.current;
      const cadenceMs = cadenceToMs(s0.cadence);
      const enoughUnits = unitsRemaining(s0.unitsUsed) >= MIN_UNITS_BUFFER;
      const autoDue =
        s0.cloudEnabled &&
        s0.apiConfigured &&
        !cloudBusyRef.current &&
        cadenceMs !== null &&
        now - lastCloudAtRef.current >= cadenceMs;
      const glowDue = (force || autoDue) && enoughUnits && !faceTooSmall(pts, srcW);
      const tonesForced = s0.tonesTick !== lastTonesTickRef.current;
      const tonesDue =
        (s0.cloudEnabled && s0.apiConfigured && !tonesDoneRef.current && enoughUnits && !faceTooSmall(pts, srcW)) ||
        (tonesForced && enoughUnits && !faceTooSmall(pts, srcW));
      if (tonesDue) lastTonesTickRef.current = s0.tonesTick;

      if (glowDue || tonesDue) {
        if (glowDue) {
          lastReScoreTick.current = s0.reScoreTick;
          lastCloudAtRef.current = now;
        }
        cloudBusyRef.current = true;
        try {
          if (glowDue) {
            const glow = await runCloudGlow(source, pts, srcW, srcH);
            if (glow !== null) {
              setGlowScore(glow);
              // blend: geometry 60% + YouCam glow 40%
              setBeautyScore(Math.round(geo * 0.6 + glow * 0.4));
            }
            setApiMode('youcam', true);
          }
          if (tonesDue) {
            const tones = await runCloudTones(source, pts, srcW, srcH);
            tonesDoneRef.current = true;
            if (tones.skinToneHex) setSkinTone(tones.skinToneHex);
            setApiMode('youcam', true);
          }
          setLastUpdate(Date.now());
        } catch (err) {
          console.warn('YouCam cloud score failed — keeping on-device score', err);
          setApiMode('youcam', false);
          setApiError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err));
        } finally {
          cloudBusyRef.current = false;
        }
      }
    },
    [runCloudGlow, runCloudTones, setApiMode, setBeautyScore, setEmotion, setGlowScore, setSkinTone, setLastUpdate, setSkinAge]
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Shared result handler
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const handleResults = useCallback(
    (results: FaceLandmarkerResult, source: CanvasImageSource, srcW: number, srcH: number, mirror: boolean) => {
      const canvas = canvasRef.current;
      if (!canvas) return;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      if (!ctx) return;

      if (!rendererRef.current) rendererRef.current = new OverlayRenderer();

      const { filter, emotion, showMesh, skinTone } = useStore.getState();
      const landmarks: { x: number; y: number; z: number }[] =
        results.faceLandmarks?.[0]?.map((l) => ({ x: l.x, y: l.y, z: l.z ?? 0 })) ?? [];

      rendererRef.current.draw(
        ctx,
        source,
        landmarks,
        { w: srcW, h: srcH },
        { w: canvas.width, h: canvas.height },
        mirror,
        { filter, emotion, showMesh, skinTone },
        performance.now()
      );

      // publish to the AI studio (used by makeup/aging/skin-report buttons)
      setFrameSnap({ source, w: srcW, h: srcH, pts: landmarks });

      if (landmarks.length >= 468) {
        void runScore(source, srcW, srcH, landmarks, results.faceBlendshapes);
      }
    },
    [runScore]
  );

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // LIVE camera pipeline
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const startLive = useCallback(async () => {
    const video = videoRef.current;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!video || !canvas) return;

    const runId = ++runIdRef.current;
    setStatus('loading');
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { width: { ideal: CANVAS_W }, height: { ideal: CANVAS_H }, facingMode: 'user' },
      audio: false,
    });
    if (runId !== runIdRef.current || stopRef.current) {
      // Only release the stream if no newer run is actively using it.
      if (streamRef.current !== stream) stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      return;
    }
    streamRef.current = stream;
    video.srcObject = stream;
    try {
      await video.play();
    } catch (err) {
      // play() aborts when cleanup (or StrictMode remount) swaps the source
      if (runId !== runIdRef.current || stopRef.current) return;
      throw err;
    }

    const landmarker = await getLandmarker('VIDEO');
    if (runId !== runIdRef.current || stopRef.current) return;

    setStatus('running');
    let fpsFrames = 0;
    let fpsAt = performance.now();

    const loop = async () => {
      if (stopRef.current) return;
      try {
        const results = await landmarker.detectForVideo(video, performance.now());
        const w = video.videoWidth || CANVAS_W;
        const h = video.videoHeight || CANVAS_H;
        handleResults(results, video, w, h, true);

        fpsFrames++;
        const t = performance.now();
        if (t - fpsAt >= 1000) {
          setFps(fpsFrames);
          fpsFrames = 0;
          fpsAt = t;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('detectForVideo error', err);
      }
      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [handleResults, setFps]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DEMO reel pipeline (works without camera permissions)
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  const startDemo = useCallback(async () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    const runId = ++runIdRef.current;
    setStatus('loading');
    const images = await Promise.all(DEMO_FACES.map(preloadImage));
    if (runId !== runIdRef.current || stopRef.current) return;

    const landmarker = await getLandmarker('IMAGE');
    if (runId !== runIdRef.current || stopRef.current) return;
    setStatus('running');

    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    let startAt = performance.now();
    let imgIdx = 0;
    let fpsFrames = 0;
    let fpsAt = performance.now();
    let lastDetect = 0;
    const DETECT_INTERVAL = 90; // ms — IMAGE-mode inference is synchronous

    const loop = () => {
      if (stopRef.current) return;
      const now = performance.now();
      const elapsed = now - startAt;

      // switch image after DEMO_IMAGE_MS
      if (elapsed >= DEMO_IMAGE_MS) {
        imgIdx = (imgIdx + 1) % images.length;
        startAt = now;
        rendererRef.current?.reset();
      }
      setDemoIndex(imgIdx);

      // Ken-Burns gentle zoom for a "live" feel
      const img = images[imgIdx];
      const prog = Math.min(1, elapsed / DEMO_IMAGE_MS);
      const zoom = 1.0 + 0.055 * prog;
      const iw = img.naturalWidth;
      const ih = img.naturalHeight;
      const baseScale = Math.max(CANVAS_W / iw, CANVAS_H / ih);
      const scale = baseScale * zoom;
      const dw = iw * scale;
      const dh = ih * scale;
      const dx = (CANVAS_W - dw) / 2 + Math.sin(prog * Math.PI * 2) * CANVAS_W * 0.01;
      const dy = (CANVAS_H - dh) / 2;
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H);
      ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);

      // IMAGE-mode detection on the canvas we just painted (throttled —
      // synchronous inference, so we don't need it at display rate).
      if (now - lastDetect >= DETECT_INTERVAL) {
        lastDetect = now;
        const results = landmarker.detect(ctx.canvas);
        handleResults(results, ctx.canvas, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H, false);
      }

      fpsFrames++;
      const t = performance.now();
      if (t - fpsAt >= 1000) {
        setFps(fpsFrames);
        fpsFrames = 0;
        fpsAt = t;
      }
      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }, [handleResults, setFps]);

  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Boot / teardown
  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

  useEffect(() => {
    stopRef.current = false;
    setStatus('loading');

    (async () => {
      try {
        if (mode === 'live') await startLive();
        else await startDemo();
      } catch (err) {
        // AbortError = interrupted by remount / source swap → not a real failure
        if (err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'AbortError') return;
        console.error('Vision pipeline failed to start', err);
        setStatus('failed');
        onError(
          err instanceof DOMException && err.name === 'NotAllowedError'
            ? 'Camera permission was denied. Grant camera access or try the Demo Reel — no camera needed.'
            : `Could not start the vision pipeline: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`
        );
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      stopRef.current = true;
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      streamRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [mode, startLive, startDemo, onError]);

  // probe the backend once: does it hold a YouCam API key?
  useEffect(() => {
    let dead = false;
    apiHealth().then((ok) => {
      if (!dead) setApiConfigured(ok);
    });
    return () => {
      dead = true;
    };
  }, [setApiConfigured]);

  const { emotion, emotionConfidence, beautyScore, apiMode, apiHealthy, apiError, fps, skinTone, showMesh, glowScore } =
    useStore();

  return (
    <Box sx={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', maxWidth: CANVAS_W, mx: 'auto' }}>
      {/* hidden video for live mode */}
      <video ref={videoRef} style={{ display: 'none' }} autoPlay muted playsInline />

      <Paper
        elevation={0}
        sx={{
          position: 'relative',
          borderRadius: 16,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          background: '#181715',
          aspectRatio: `${CANVAS_W} / ${CANVAS_H}`,
          boxShadow: '0 24px 70px rgba(20,20,19,0.45)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(250,249,245,0.1)',
        }}
      >
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          width={CANVAS_W}
          height={CANVAS_H}
          style={{ width: '100%', height: '100%', display: 'block' }}
          aria-label="Live AR preview with makeup overlay and particles"
        />

        {/* legibility vignette — content fades at the edges */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            inset: 0,
            pointerEvents: 'none',
            background:
              'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.22) 0%, transparent 22%, transparent 66%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 100%)',
          }}
        />

        {/* loading overlay */}
        {status !== 'running' && (
          <Box
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              inset: 0,
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              gap: 1.5,
              background: 'rgba(10,10,12,0.82)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)',
              color: '#fff',
            }}
          >
            <CircularProgress color="secondary" size={40} />
            <Typography variant="body2">
              {status === 'failed' ? 'Pipeline failed' : 'Loading face-mesh AI…'}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        )}

        {/* demo reel caption */}
        {mode === 'demo' && status === 'running' && (
          <Chip
            size="small"
            label={`Demo reel · sample ${demoIndex + 1}/${DEMO_FACES.length}`}
            sx={{
              position: 'absolute',
              top: 10,
              left: 10,
              background: 'rgba(28,28,30,0.6)',
              color: '#fff',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(16px) saturate(180%)',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14)',
            }}
          />
        )}

        {/* status chips */}
        <Box
          sx={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: 10,
            right: 10,
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            gap: 0.6,
            alignItems: 'flex-end',
          }}
        >
          <Chip
            size="small"
            icon={<AutoAwesomeIcon fontSize="small" />}
            label={
              apiMode === 'youcam'
                ? apiHealthy
                  ? 'YouCam Cloud'
                  : apiError && /credit/i.test(apiError)
                    ? 'Credits exhausted'
                    : 'YouCam (offline)'
                : 'On-device AI'
            }
            color={apiMode === 'youcam' && !apiHealthy && apiError && /credit/i.test(apiError) ? 'error' : 'default'}
            sx={{ background: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)', color: '#fff', backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)' }}

import { Box, Typography } from '@mui/material';
import { useSpring } from '../utils/spring';

interface Props {
  value: number;
  label?: string;
  color?: string;
  size?: number;
}

function colorFor(value: number): string {
  if (value >= 80) return '#5db872'; // Claude success
  if (value >= 65) return '#d4a017'; // Claude warning
  return '#c64545'; // Claude error
}

/**
 * Apple-watch-style spring ring gauge:
 *  - the arc follows the value through a spring (interruptible, velocity-aware)
 *  - the numeral animates on the same spring so they never desync
 *  - color-coded like iOS labels
 */
export const ScoreGauge: React.FC<Props> = ({ value, label = 'Beauty Score', color, size = 78 }) => {
  const animated = useSpring(value, { stiffness: 200, damping: 26 });
  const display = Math.round(animated);
  const arc = color ?? colorFor(display);

  const R = 34;
  const C = 2 * Math.PI * R;
  const offset = C * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(1, animated / 100)));

  return (
    <Box
      role="meter"
      aria-valuenow={display}
      aria-valuemin={0}
      aria-valuemax={100}
      aria-label={`${label} ${display} out of 100`}
      sx={{ position: 'relative', display: 'inline-flex', flexShrink: 0, width: size, height: size }}
    >
      <svg viewBox="0 0 76 76" width={size} height={size} style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0 }}>
        {/* track */}
        <circle cx="38" cy="38" r={R} fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.14)" strokeWidth="7" />
        {/* value arc — spring-driven */}
        <circle
          cx="38"
          cy="38"
          r={R}
          fill="none"
          stroke={arc}
          strokeWidth="7"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeDasharray={C}
          strokeDashoffset={offset}
          transform="rotate(-90 38 38)"
          style={{ transition: 'stroke 300ms ease' }}
        />
      </svg>
      <Box
        sx={{
          position: 'absolute',
          inset: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          lineHeight: 1,
        }}
      >
        <Typography
          sx={{
            fontSize: 21,
            fontWeight: 700,
            letterSpacing: '-0.03em',
            fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums',
            color: '#fff',
          }}
        >
          {display}
        </Typography>
        <Typography
          sx={{
            mt: 0.4,
            fontSize: 8,
            fontWeight: 650,
            letterSpacing: '0.07em',
            textTransform: 'uppercase',
            color: 'rgba(235,235,245,0.5)',
          }}
        >
          {label}
        </Typography>
      </Box>
    </Box>
  );
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// YouCam Cloud API types — mirror the sandbox endpoints documented in the
// hackathon brief:
//   POST /s2s/v2.0/task/skin-analysis      -> { results.output[]: {type, ui_score, ...} }
//   POST /s2s/v2.0/task/skin-tone-analysis -> { results.color: {skin_color, ...} }

export type EmotionLabel =
  | 'happy'
  | 'sad'
  | 'angry'
  | 'surprised'
  | 'neutral'
  | 'fearful'
  | 'disgust';

export interface BeautifyResponse {
  /** 0–100 beauty score */
  beautyScore: number;
  /** skin tone as hex color, e.g. "#f5d2a1" */
  skinTone: string;
  skinToneScore?: number;
  faceShape?: string;
  age?: number;
  gender?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface EmotionResponse {
  emotion: EmotionLabel;
  /** 0–1 confidence */
  confidence: number;
}

export interface YouCamError {
  code?: number | string;
  message?: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// On-device analysis — the zero-credential fallback that mirrors the YouCam
// of the YouCam skin-analysis endpoints using Mediapipe's 478-point face mesh
// and 52 facial blendshapes. Everything runs in the browser; nothing leaves
// the device.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import type { EmotionLabel } from '../types/youcam';

export interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  z: number;
}

export interface BlendShape {
  categoryName: string;
  score: number;
}

// ---- Landmark indices (Mediapipe 478-point face mesh topology) -----------
export const IDX = {
  noseTip: 1,
  noseBridge: 168,
  chin: 152,
  forehead: 10,
  leftCheek: 234,
  rightCheek: 454,
  leftEyeOuter: 33,
  leftEyeInner: 133,
  rightEyeOuter: 263,
  rightEyeInner: 362,
  mouthLeft: 61,
  mouthRight: 291,
  mouthTop: 13,
  mouthBottom: 14,
  lipsOuter: [61, 146, 91, 181, 84, 17, 314, 405, 321, 375, 291, 409, 270, 269, 267, 0, 37, 39, 40, 185] as const,
  leftBrowMid: 70,
  rightBrowMid: 300,
} as const;

/** Symmetry landmark pairs: [leftIdx, rightIdx] across the face midline. */
const SYMMETRY_PAIRS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [number, number]> = [
  [33, 263],
  [133, 362],
  [61, 291],
  [39, 269],
  [0, 267],
  [234, 454],
  [70, 300],
  [10, 338],
  [50, 280],
  [159, 386],
];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Emotion classification from blendshapes
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

function bs(blendshapes: BlendShape[], name: string): number {
  const found = blendshapes.find((b) => b.categoryName === name);
  return found ? found.score : 0;
}

/**
 * Maps Mediapipe blendshape scores to the same 7-class label space as the
 * the YouCam emotion label space (kept on-device: free, instant, private).
 */
export function classifyEmotion(
  blendshapes: BlendShape[] | null | undefined,
  landmarks?: Point[]
): { emotion: EmotionLabel; confidence: number } {
  if (blendshapes && blendshapes.length > 0) {
    const smile = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'mouthSmileLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'mouthSmileRight'));
    const frown = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'mouthFrownLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'mouthFrownRight'));
    const jawOpen = bs(blendshapes, 'jawOpen');
    const browDown = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'browDownLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'browDownRight'));
    const browUp = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'browInnerUp'), bs(blendshapes, 'browOuterUpLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'browOuterUpRight'));
    const eyeWide = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'eyeWideLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'eyeWideRight'));
    const sneer = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'noseSneerLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'noseSneerRight'));
    const press = Math.max(bs(blendshapes, 'mouthPressLeft'), bs(blendshapes, 'mouthPressRight'));

    if (smile > 0.45) return { emotion: 'happy', confidence: Math.min(0.99, 0.55 + smile * 0.45) };
    if (jawOpen > 0.4 && (browUp > 0.22 || eyeWide > 0.35)) return { emotion: 'surprised', confidence: Math.min(0.95, 0.5 + jawOpen * 0.4) };
    if (browDown > 0.5 && press > 0.3) return { emotion: 'angry', confidence: Math.min(0.95, 0.5 + browDown * 0.4) };
    if (sneer > 0.45 && browDown > 0.2) return { emotion: 'disgust', confidence: Math.min(0.9, 0.5 + sneer * 0.4) };
    if (frown > 0.3 || (browUp > 0.45 && press > 0.25)) return { emotion: 'sad', confidence: Math.min(0.9, 0.5 + Math.max(frown, browUp) * 0.35) };
    if (browUp > 0.5 && eyeWide > 0.4) return { emotion: 'fearful', confidence: Math.min(0.85, 0.5 + browUp * 0.3) };

    const signals = Math.max(smile, frown, jawOpen, browDown, browUp, sneer);
    return { emotion: 'neutral', confidence: Math.max(0.3, 1 - signals) };
  }

  // Geometry fallback (no blendshapes available): smile detection via mouth
  // corner curve.
  if (landmarks && landmarks.length > 0) {
    const L = landmarks[IDX.mouthLeft];
    const R = landmarks[IDX.mouthRight];
    const top = landmarks[IDX.mouthTop];
    const bot = landmarks[IDX.mouthBottom];
    const mouthW = Math.hypot(R.x - L.x, R.y - L.y) || 1e-6;
    const cornerY = (L.y + R.y) / 2;
    const topOffset = (cornerY - top.y) / mouthW;
    const botOffset = (bot.y - cornerY) / mouthW;
    const curve = (topOffset + botOffset) / 2;
    if (curve > 0.42) return { emotion: 'happy', confidence: Math.min(0.9, 0.5 + curve) };
    if (botOffset > 0.6) return { emotion: 'surprised', confidence: 0.6 };
    if (curve < 0.12) return { emotion: 'sad', confidence: 0.55 };
    return { emotion: 'neutral', confidence: 0.5 };
  }

  return { emotion: 'neutral', confidence: 0.3 };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Beauty score (geometry heuristics)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

/** Gaussian falloff scoring: 100 at the target, decaying with tolerance. */
function gauss(value: number, target: number, tolerance: number): number {
  return 100 * Math.exp(-Math.pow((value - target) / tolerance, 2));
}

/**
 * Computes a deterministic 0–100 beauty score from facial geometry:
 *  - symmetry across the vertical midline (35%)
 *  - facial proportions / golden-ratio checks (30%)
 *  - facial harmony (20%)
 *  - expression bonus (15%)
 *
 * `last` is the previous score for EMA smoothing (optional).
 */
export function computeBeautyScore(landmarks: Point[], last?: number): number {
  if (!landmarks || landmarks.length < 468) return last ?? 0;

  const p = (i: number) => landmarks[i];
  const noseX = p(IDX.noseBridge).x;

  // --- symmetry ---
  const leftCheek = p(IDX.leftCheek);
  const rightCheek = p(IDX.rightCheek);
  const faceWidth = Math.hypot(rightCheek.x - leftCheek.x, rightCheek.y - leftCheek.y) || 1e-6;

  let symErr = 0;
  for (const [li, ri] of SYMMETRY_PAIRS) {
    const l = p(li);
    const r = p(ri);
    const err = Math.abs(l.x - noseX + (r.x - noseX));
    symErr += err;
  }
  symErr /= SYMMETRY_PAIRS.length;
  const symScore = 100 * clamp(1 - symErr / (faceWidth * 0.22), 0.45, 1);

  // --- proportions ---
  const chin = p(IDX.chin);
  const browL = p(IDX.leftBrowMid);
  const browR = p(IDX.rightBrowMid);
  const eyeL = p(IDX.leftEyeOuter);
  const eyeR = p(IDX.rightEyeOuter);
  const mouthL = p(IDX.mouthLeft);
  const mouthR = p(IDX.mouthRight);
  const forehead = p(IDX.forehead);

  const faceHeight = Math.hypot(chin.x - forehead.x, chin.y - forehead.y) || 1e-6;
  const browY = (browL.y + browR.y) / 2;

  // Vertical thirds: brow→chin should be ~3/4 of forehead→chin (brow sits
  // ~1/3 down from hairline to chin).
  const browToChin = Math.abs(browY - chin.y) / faceHeight; // target ≈ 0.78–0.85
  const thirds = gauss(browToChin, 0.82, 0.09);

  // Interocular width vs face width (target ≈ 0.46, golden-ratio harmony)
  const eyeDist = Math.hypot(eyeR.x - eyeL.x, eyeR.y - eyeL.y);
  const eyeRatio = eyeDist / faceWidth;
  const eyeScore = gauss(eyeRatio, 0.46, 0.09);

  // Mouth width vs face width (target ≈ 0.5)
  const mouthW = Math.hypot(mouthR.x - mouthL.x, mouthR.y - mouthL.y);
  const mouthRatio = mouthW / faceWidth;
  const mouthScore = gauss(mouthRatio, 0.5, 0.11);

  // --- harmony: symmetry between eye-to-mouth on both sides ---
  const noseTip = p(IDX.noseTip);
  const distL = Math.hypot(eyeL.x - noseTip.x, eyeL.y - noseTip.y);
  const distR = Math.hypot(eyeR.x - noseTip.x, eyeR.y - noseTip.y);
  const harmonyErr = Math.abs(distL - distR) / Math.max(distL, distR);
  const harmonyScore = 100 * clamp(1 - harmonyErr / 0.35, 0.5, 1);

  const raw =
    symScore * 0.35 + (thirds * 0.12 + eyeScore * 0.1 + mouthScore * 0.08) + harmonyScore * 0.2;

  // --- expression bonus: a genuine smile reads as "glowing" ---
  const mouthCurve = (mouthL.y + mouthR.y) / 2 - Math.min(p(IDX.mouthTop).y, p(13).y);
  const smileFactor = clamp((mouthCurve / faceHeight) * 6, 0, 1);
  const withSmile = raw * 0.85 + smileFactor * 14;

  // Lift typical faces into the 75–92 band (these apps are meant to flatter);
  // the ranking between faces is preserved, only the baseline moves up.
  const lifted = 100 - (100 - withSmile) * 0.42;

  const final = clamp(Math.round(lifted), 55, 99);
  if (last !== undefined && last > 0) {
    return Math.round(last * 0.55 + final * 0.45); // EMA smooths jitter
  }
  return final;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skin tone sampling
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Samples average skin color from the cheek regions of the source image and
 * returns it as a hex string (e.g. "#d9a77c"). Returns null when the face is
 * too small or sampling fails.
 */
export function sampleSkinTone(
  image: CanvasImageSource,
  landmarks: Point[],
  sourceW: number,
  sourceH: number
): string | null {
  if (!landmarks || landmarks.length < 468) return null;
  try {
    const off = document.createElement('canvas');
    const ctx = off.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    if (!ctx) return null;
    off.width = sourceW;
    off.height = sourceH;
    ctx.drawImage(image, 0, 0, sourceW, sourceH);

    const cheekR = Math.max(4, Math.round(sourceW * 0.025));
    const sample = (idx: number) => {
      const cx = Math.round(landmarks[idx].x * sourceW);
      const cy = Math.round(landmarks[idx].y * sourceH);
      const x0 = Math.max(0, cx - cheekR);
      const y0 = Math.max(0, cy - cheekR);
      const w = Math.min(cheekR * 2, sourceW - x0);
      const h = Math.min(cheekR * 2, sourceH - y0);
      if (w <= 0 || h <= 0) return null;
      const data = ctx.getImageData(x0, y0, w, h).data;
      let r = 0, g = 0, b = 0, n = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
        // skip near-white (specular) and near-black pixels
        const rr = data[i], gg = data[i + 1], bb = data[i + 2];
        if (rr < 245 && gg < 245 && bb < 245 && rr > 20 && gg > 15 && bb > 10) {
          r += rr; g += gg; b += bb; n++;
        }
      }
      if (n < 4) return null;
      return { r: r / n, g: g / n, b: b / n };
    };

    const L = sample(IDX.leftCheek);
    const R = sample(IDX.rightCheek);
    if (!L && !R) return null;
    const avg = L && R ? { r: (L.r + R.r) / 2, g: (L.g + R.g) / 2, b: (L.b + R.b) / 2 } : (L ?? R)!;

    const hex = (v: number) =>
      Math.round(clamp(v, 0, 255)).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    return `#${hex(avg.r)}${hex(avg.g)}${hex(avg.b)}`.toUpperCase();
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Rough perceptual luminance of a hex color (0–255). */
export function hexLuminance(hex: string): number {
  const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex.trim());
  if (!m) return 128;
  const n = parseInt(m[1], 16);
  const r = (n >> 16) & 255;
  const g = (n >> 8) & 255;
  const b = n & 255;
  return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b;
}

// AR overlay renderer: draws the video frame, landmark-anchored makeup
// (lip tint, eyeshadow, blush, glow), an optional face-mesh wireframe, and an
// emotion-driven particle system (confetti / rain / sparkles / embers).

const FACE_OVAL = [
  10, 338, 297, 332, 284, 251, 389, 356, 454, 323, 361, 288, 397, 365, 379, 378,
  400, 377, 152, 148, 176, 149, 150, 136, 172, 58, 132, 93, 234, 127, 162, 21,

const LEFT_BROW = [70, 63, 105, 66, 107];
const RIGHT_BROW = [300, 293, 334, 296, 336];
const LEFT_EYE = [33, 7, 163, 144, 145, 153, 154, 155, 133, 173, 157, 158, 159, 160, 161, 246];
const RIGHT_EYE = [263, 249, 390, 373, 374, 380, 381, 382, 362, 398, 384, 385, 386, 387, 388, 466];
const NOSE = [168, 6, 195, 4, 1, 19, 94, 2, 164, 0, 11, 12, 166, 121, 125, 78, 191, 80, 81, 82, 13, 312, 311, 310, 415, 308, 324, 318, 402, 317, 14, 87, 178, 88, 95, 78];
const LIPS_OUTER = [61, 146, 91, 181, 84, 17, 314, 405, 321, 375, 291, 409, 270, 269, 267, 0, 37, 39, 40, 185];
const LIPS_INNER = [78, 95, 88, 178, 87, 14, 317, 402, 318, 324, 308, 415, 310, 311, 312, 13, 82, 81, 80, 191];

/** Order points by angle around their centroid so `fill()` gets a clean silhouette. */
function orderByAngle(pts: Point[]): Point[] {
  if (pts.length === 0) return pts;
  const cx = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.x, 0) / pts.length;
  const cy = pts.reduce((s, p) => s + p.y, 0) / pts.length;
  return [...pts].sort((a, b) => Math.atan2(a.y - cy, a.x - cx) - Math.atan2(b.y - cy, b.x - cx));
}

function mixHex(a: string, b: string, t: number): string {
  const p = (h: string) => {
    const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(h.trim());
    if (!m) return [128, 128, 128];
    const n = parseInt(m[1], 16);
    return [(n >> 16) & 255, (n >> 8) & 255, n & 255];
  };
  const ca = p(a);
  const cb = p(b);
  const c = ca.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (cb[i] - v) * t));
  const hex = (v: number) => Math.round(v).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  return `#${hex(c[0])}${hex(c[1])}${hex(c[2])}`;
}

function hexToRgba(hex: string, alpha: number): string {
  const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex.trim());
  if (!m) return `rgba(200,60,90,${alpha})`;
  const n = parseInt(m[1], 16);
  return `rgba(${(n >> 16) & 255},${(n >> 8) & 255},${n & 255},${alpha})`;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Particles
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type ParticleKind = 'confetti' | 'rain' | 'sparkle' | 'ember' | 'shimmer';

interface Particle {
  kind: ParticleKind;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  rot: number;
  vr: number;
  size: number;
  color: string;
  life: number;
  maxLife: number;
  phase: number;
}

const CONFETTI_COLORS = ['#f43f5e', '#f59e0b', '#22c55e', '#3b82f6', '#a855f7', '#ec4899', '#facc15'];

function spawnParticles(
  list: Particle[],
  kind: ParticleKind,
  count: number,
  w: number,
  h: number
): void {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    list.push({
      kind,
      x: Math.random() * w,
      y: kind === 'sparkle' || kind === 'ember' ? h * (0.35 + Math.random() * 0.55) : -20 - Math.random() * 60,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60,
      vy: kind === 'rain' ? 620 + Math.random() * 420 : kind === 'confetti' ? 160 + Math.random() * 160 : kind === 'ember' ? -(90 + Math.random() * 130) : -(30 + Math.random() * 60),
      rot: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      vr: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
      size: kind === 'confetti' ? 6 + Math.random() * 7 : kind === 'rain' ? 14 + Math.random() * 8 : 3 + Math.random() * 5,
      color: kind === 'confetti' ? CONFETTI_COLORS[i % CONFETTI_COLORS.length] : kind === 'ember' ? '#fb923c' : '#fef3c7',
      life: 1,
      maxLife: kind === 'confetti' || kind === 'rain' ? 5 + Math.random() * 3 : 2 + Math.random() * 2,
      phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
    });
  }
}

function updateParticles(list: Particle[], dt: number): void {
  for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = list[i];
    p.life -= dt / p.maxLife;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      list.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    if (p.kind === 'confetti') {
      p.vy += 340 * dt;
      p.vx += Math.sin(p.phase + p.life * 8) * 60 * dt;
      p.rot += p.vr * dt;
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    } else if (p.kind === 'rain') {
      p.x += p.vx * dt;
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
    } else if (p.kind === 'sparkle') {
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.x += Math.sin(p.phase + p.life * 10) * 24 * dt;
      p.rot += p.vr * dt;
    } else if (p.kind === 'ember') {
      p.y += p.vy * dt;
      p.x += Math.sin(p.phase + p.life * 12) * 30 * dt;
    } else {
      // shimmer — slow drift
      p.x += p.vx * dt * 0.4;
      p.y += p.vy * dt * 0.4;
    }
    if (p.y > 520 || p.y < -80) list.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

function drawParticles(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, list: Particle[]): void {
  for (const p of list) {
    const fade = Math.min(1, p.life * 2.5);
    if (p.kind === 'confetti') {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92 * fade;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.fillRect(-p.size / 2, -p.size / 3, p.size, p.size * 0.66);
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.kind === 'rain') {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55 * fade;
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(147,181,255,0.9)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - 3, p.y + p.size);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.kind === 'sparkle') {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      const s = p.size * (0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(p.life * 12 + p.phase));
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95 * fade;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -s);
      ctx.lineTo(s * 0.28, -s * 0.28);
      ctx.lineTo(s, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(s * 0.28, s * 0.28);
      ctx.lineTo(0, s);
      ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.28, s * 0.28);
      ctx.lineTo(-s, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.28, -s * 0.28);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.kind === 'ember') {
      const flicker = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(p.life * 18 + p.phase);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85 * fade * flicker;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 * fade;
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)';
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.35, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function particleKindFor(emotion: EmotionLabel): ParticleKind {
  switch (emotion) {
    case 'happy':
      return 'confetti';
    case 'sad':
      return 'rain';
    case 'surprised':
      return 'sparkle';
    case 'angry':
      return 'ember';
    default:
      return 'shimmer';
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Renderer
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface OverlayOptions {
  filter: FilterConfig;
  emotion: EmotionLabel;
  showMesh: boolean;
  skinTone: string | null;
}

export interface SourceDims {
  w: number;
  h: number;
}

export class OverlayRenderer {
  private particles: Particle[] = [];
  private lastEmotion: EmotionLabel | null = null;
  private lastT = 0;

  /**
   * Draws one frame. `landmarks` are normalized (0..1) Mediapipe coordinates.
   * `mirror` horizontally flips both the source image and the landmarks
   * (selfie view for live camera).
   */
  draw(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    image: CanvasImageSource,
    landmarks: Point[],
    source: SourceDims,
    canvas: { w: number; h: number },
    mirror: boolean,
    opts: OverlayOptions,
    now: number
  ): void {
    const { w: cw, h: ch } = canvas;

    // ---- source transform (cover-fit) ----
    const scale = Math.max(cw / source.w, ch / source.h);
    const ox = (cw - source.w * scale) / 2;
    const oy = (ch - source.h * scale) / 2;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);
    ctx.save();
    if (mirror) {
      ctx.translate(cw, 0);
      ctx.scale(-1, 1);
    }
    ctx.drawImage(image, ox, oy, source.w * scale, source.h * scale);
    ctx.restore();

    const pt = (lm: Point) => {
      let x = lm.x * source.w * scale + ox;
      const y = lm.y * source.h * scale + oy;
      if (mirror) x = cw - x;
      return { x, y };
    };

    const hasFace = landmarks.length >= 468;

    if (hasFace) {
      this.drawMakeup(ctx, landmarks, pt, opts, now);
      if (opts.showMesh) this.drawMesh(ctx, landmarks, pt);
    }

    // ---- particles ----
    if (opts.filter.particles) {
      if (this.lastEmotion !== opts.emotion) {
        const kind = particleKindFor(opts.emotion);
        const count = kind === 'confetti' ? 70 : kind === 'rain' ? 55 : kind === 'sparkle' ? 45 : 30;
        spawnParticles(this.particles, kind, count, cw, ch);
        this.lastEmotion = opts.emotion;
      }
      const kind = particleKindFor(opts.emotion);
      if (kind === 'shimmer' && this.particles.length < 40 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
        spawnParticles(this.particles, 'shimmer', 1, cw, ch);
      }
      const dt = this.lastT ? Math.min(0.1, Math.max(1 / 60, (now - this.lastT) / 1000)) : 1 / 60;
      this.lastT = now;
      updateParticles(this.particles, dt);
      drawParticles(ctx, this.particles);
    }
  }

  private drawMakeup(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    landmarks: Point[],
    pt: (p: Point) => { x: number; y: number },
    opts: OverlayOptions,
    now: number
  ): void {
    const { filter } = opts;
    const skinTone = opts.skinTone ?? '#d9a77c';
    const skinDark = hexLuminance(skinTone) < 100;

    // ---- glow ----
    if (filter.glow) {
      const nose = pt(landmarks[1]);
      const lCheek = pt(landmarks[234]);
      const rCheek = pt(landmarks[454]);
      const faceW = Math.hypot(rCheek.x - lCheek.x, rCheek.y - lCheek.y);
      const breathe = 0.05 + 0.02 * Math.sin(now / 900);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(nose.x, nose.y, faceW * 0.1, nose.x, nose.y, faceW * 0.85);
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,255,255,${breathe + 0.05})`);
      g.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(244,114,182,${breathe * 0.6})`);
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(244,114,182,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(nose.x, nose.y, faceW * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }

    // ---- blush ----
    if (filter.blush) {
      const cheekIdx = [234, 454];
      const lCheek = pt(landmarks[234]);
      const rCheek = pt(landmarks[454]);
      const faceW = Math.hypot(rCheek.x - lCheek.x, rCheek.y - lCheek.y);
      const blushColor = mixHex('#f43f5e', skinTone, skinDark ? 0.35 : 0.55);
      for (const idx of cheekIdx) {
        const c = pt(landmarks[idx]);
        const r = faceW * 0.16;
        const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, r * 0.1, c.x, c.y, r);
        g.addColorStop(0, hexToRgba(blushColor, 0.2));
        g.addColorStop(1, hexToRgba(blushColor, 0));
        ctx.fillStyle = g;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // ---- eyeshadow ----
    if (filter.eyeshadow) {
      const eyes: Array<[number, number, number]> = [
        [33, 133, 159], // left: outer, inner, upper-lid midpoint
        [263, 362, 386], // right
      ];
      const shadowColor = mixHex(filter.lipColor, '#7c3aed', 0.5);
      for (const [outerIdx, innerIdx, lidIdx] of eyes) {
        const outer = pt(landmarks[outerIdx]);
        const inner = pt(landmarks[innerIdx]);
        const lid = pt(landmarks[lidIdx]);
        const eyeW = Math.hypot(inner.x - outer.x, inner.y - outer.y);
        const cx = (outer.x + inner.x) / 2;
        const cy = (outer.y + inner.y + lid.y) / 3 - eyeW * 0.12;
        ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(shadowColor, 0.28);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, eyeW * 0.62, eyeW * 0.34, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = hexToRgba(mixHex(shadowColor, '#ffffff', 0.35), 0.18);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - eyeW * 0.06, eyeW * 0.4, eyeW * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
    }

    // ---- lip tint ----
    const lipIdx = [...LIPS_OUTER];
    const lipPts = orderByAngle(
      lipIdx.map((i) => landmarks[i]).filter((p): p is Point => Boolean(p))
    );
    if (lipPts.length > 3) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = filter.lipOpacity;
      ctx.fillStyle = filter.lipColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      lipPts.forEach((p, i) => {
        const c = pt(p);
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y);
      });
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();

      // gloss highlight on the lower lip
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.28 * filter.lipOpacity;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.beginPath();
      const lower = pt(landmarks[17]);
      const leftC = pt(landmarks[61]);
      const rightC = pt(landmarks[291]);
      const lipW = Math.hypot(rightC.x - leftC.x, rightC.y - leftC.y);
      ctx.ellipse(lower.x, lower.y + lipW * 0.02, lipW * 0.22, lipW * 0.07, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
  }

  private drawMesh(
    ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
    landmarks: Point[],
    pt: (p: Point) => { x: number; y: number }
  ): void {
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(103,232,249,0.75)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    for (const contour of CONTOURS) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      contour.forEach((idx, i) => {
        const c = pt(landmarks[idx]);
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(c.x, c.y);
        else ctx.lineTo(c.x, c.y);
      });
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(103,232,249,0.9)';
    for (let i = 0; i < landmarks.length; i += 2) {
      const c = pt(landmarks[i]);
      ctx.fillRect(c.x - 0.5, c.y - 0.5, 1.2, 1.2);
    }
  }

  /** Clears particle state (e.g. when the source changes). */
  reset(): void {
    this.particles = [];
    this.lastEmotion = null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Minimal spring engine — the Apple "behavior over animation" principle:
//   - animates FROM the current value (interruptible at any instant)
//   - carries velocity through re-targets (no "brick wall" on reversal)
//   - settle time emerges from stiffness/damping (no fixed duration)
//   - respects prefers-reduced-motion (snaps instead of animating)
//
// Semantically maps to Apple's designer params: damping ≈ damping ratio
// (higher = less bounce), stiffness ≈ 1/response² (higher = snappier).
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export interface SpringConfig {
  /** stiffness — how snappy (default 180) */
  stiffness?: number;
  /** damping — 1.0-ish critical; lower = bouncier (default 26) */
  damping?: number;
  mass?: number;
  precision?: number;
}

const prefersReduced = (): boolean =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
  window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/**
 * Returns the current spring value for `target` — updating every frame with
 * semi-implicit Euler integration. Interrupting (changing target mid-flight)
 * continues from the live value and current velocity.
 */
export function useSpring(
  target: number,
  { stiffness = 180, damping = 26, mass = 1, precision = 0.001 }: SpringConfig = {}
): number {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(target);
  const state = useRef({ x: target, v: 0, t: target });

  useEffect(() => {
    const s = state.current;
    s.t = target;

    if (prefersReduced()) {
      s.x = target;
      s.v = 0;
      setValue(target);
      return;
    }

    let raf = 0;
    let last = performance.now();

    const tick = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0.001, (now - last) / 1000));
      last = now;
      // a = (−k·(x−t) − c·v) / m  →  integrate velocity & position
      const a = (-stiffness * (s.x - s.t) - damping * s.v) / mass;
      s.v += a * dt;
      s.x += s.v * dt;
      setValue(s.x);
      if (Math.abs(s.x - s.t) < precision && Math.abs(s.v) < 0.01) {
        s.x = s.t;
        s.v = 0;
        setValue(s.t);
      } else {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      }
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [target, stiffness, damping, mass, precision]);

  return value;
}

/** Apple's momentum projection (Designing Fluid Interfaces sample code). */
export function projectMomentum(
  velocity: number /* px/s */,
  decelerationRate = 0.998
): number {
  return (velocity / 1000) * (decelerationRate / (1 - decelerationRate));
}

/** Progressive resistance at boundaries (rubber-banding). */
export function rubberband(
  overshoot: number,
  dimension: number,
  constant = 0.55
): number {
  return (overshoot * dimension * constant) / (dimension + constant * Math.abs(overshoot));
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// YouCam Cloud client (browser side).
//
// IMPORTANT: the YouCam V2 API is server-to-server (/s2s/) and blocks direct
// browser calls with CORS errors. All calls go through our tiny backend
// proxy (`/api/youcam` — Vercel function in production, `scripts/dev-proxy.mjs`
// locally). The API key lives ONLY on the server.
//
// VERIFIED LIVE (Aug 2026, real hackathon API key):
//   - POST /s2s/v2.0/file/{slug} → presigned S3 PUT → file_id        ✅
//   - POST /s2s/v2.0/task/skin-analysis   (4 concerns, format=json)  ✅
//        data.results.output[] = { type, ui_score, raw_score, mask_urls }
//   - POST /s2s/v2.0/task/skin-tone-analysis (format=json)            ✅
//        data.results.color = { skin_color, eye_color, lip_color, ... }
//
// UNIT COSTS (official pricing page, Aug 2026):
//   - skin-analysis SD, 1–4 concerns: 9 units
//   - skin-tone-analysis:             20 units
// Units are charged ONLY on successful tasks; errors and polling are free.

/** Real per-endpoint unit costs (configurable via env). */
const envCost = (name: string, fallback: number): number => {
  const raw = import.meta.env[`VITE_YOUCAM_UNITS_${name}`];
  const n = raw === undefined ? NaN : Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0 ? n : fallback;
};

export const UNIT_COST: Record<string, number> = {
  'skin-analysis': envCost('SKIN_ANALYSIS', 9),
  'skin-tone-analysis': envCost('SKIN_TONE_ANALYSIS', 20),
  'skin-analysis-full': envCost('SKIN_ANALYSIS_FULL', 16), // 13–16 concerns
  'makeup-vto': envCost('MAKEUP_VTO', 1),
  aging: envCost('AGING', 2),
  fitzpatrick: envCost('FITZPATRICK', 10),
};

/** Total units granted for the hackathon. */
export const TOTAL_UNITS = 1000;

/** Snapshot sent to the API — 640×480 satisfies the SD short-side ≥ 480px rule. */
export const SNAPSHOT_W = 640;
export const SNAPSHOT_H = 480;

/** Cloud call will be skipped when estimated remaining units fall below this. */
export const MIN_UNITS_BUFFER = 30;

  return Math.max(0, TOTAL_UNITS - used);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Proxy plumbing
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export async function apiHealth(): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${PROXY_BASE}?action=health`, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return false;
    const json = (await res.json()) as { configured?: boolean };
    return Boolean(json.configured);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

async function proxyJson(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<unknown> {
  const res = await fetch(`${PROXY_BASE}${path}`, {
    ...init,
    signal: init?.signal ?? AbortSignal.timeout(90_000),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let detail = '';
    try {
      detail = JSON.stringify(await res.json());
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    const msg = detail.includes('CreditInsufficien')
      ? 'API credits exhausted — add more units or a fresh key (YOUCAM_API_KEYS).'
      : `YouCam proxy ${path} failed (HTTP ${res.status}) ${detail}`;
    throw new Error(msg);
  }
  return res.json();
}

function blobToBase64(blob: Blob): Promise<string> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const result = String(reader.result ?? '');
      resolve(result.includes(',') ? result.split(',')[1] : result);
    };
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to read image'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
  });
}

async function uploadImage(blob: Blob, slug: string): Promise<string> {
  const dataBase64 = await blobToBase64(blob);
  const json = (await proxyJson(`?action=upload&slug=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      dataBase64,
      contentType: blob.type || 'image/jpeg',
      fileName: 'frame.jpg',
    }),
  })) as { file_id?: string };
  if (!json.file_id) throw new Error('upload returned no file_id');
  return json.file_id;
}

async function createTask(slug: string, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<string> {
  const json = (await proxyJson(`?action=task&slug=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })) as { task_id?: string };
  if (!json.task_id) throw new Error('task create returned no task_id');
  return json.task_id;
}

async function pollTask(slug: string, taskId: string, timeoutMs = 180_000): Promise<unknown> {
  const start = Date.now();
  let last: unknown = null;
  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {
    last = await proxyJson(
      `?action=poll&slug=${encodeURIComponent(slug)}&task_id=${encodeURIComponent(taskId)}`
    );
    const root = (last as { data?: unknown }) ?? {};
    const d = (root.data ?? root) as { task_status?: string; status?: string; error?: unknown };
    const status = d.task_status ?? d.status;
    if (status === 'success') return last;
    if (status === 'error' || status === 'failed') {
      const err = (d as { error?: unknown }).error;
      throw new Error(
        `YouCam task ${slug} failed${err ? `: ${JSON.stringify(err)}` : ''}`
      );
    }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 2500));
  }
  throw new Error(`YouCam task ${slug} polling timed out`);
}

/** Captures a JPEG snapshot from a video/canvas source. */
export async function captureJpeg(
  source: CanvasImageSource,
  width = SNAPSHOT_W,
  height = SNAPSHOT_H
): Promise<Blob> {
  const off = new OffscreenCanvas(width, height);
  const ctx = off.getContext('2d')!;
  ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0, width, height);
  return off.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/jpeg', quality: 0.82 });
}

/**
 * Captures a JPEG snapshot CROPPED TO THE FACE — the YouCam analyzers need
 * the face to occupy a large fraction of the frame (skin-tone requires
 * >60% width; skin-analysis rejects faces it deems too small). We use the
 * Mediapipe landmarks to crop a padded square around the face and draw it
 * cover-fit into the 640×480 output. Verified live: this format passes
 * both analyzers.
 */
export async function captureFaceJpeg(
  source: CanvasImageSource,
  pts: ReadonlyArray<{ x: number; y: number }>,
  srcW: number,
  srcH: number,
  width = SNAPSHOT_W,
  height = SNAPSHOT_H
): Promise<Blob> {
  if (!pts || pts.length < 468) return captureJpeg(source, width, height);

  // bounding box over the whole mesh + 18% margin
  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  for (const p of pts) {
    if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
    if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
    if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
  }
  const cx = ((minX + maxX) / 2) * srcW;
  const cy = ((minY + maxY) / 2) * srcH;
  let size = Math.max((maxX - minX) * srcW, (maxY - minY) * srcH) * 1.45;
  size = Math.min(size, Math.min(srcW, srcH));
  const half = size / 2;
  const sx = Math.max(0, Math.min(cx - half, srcW - size));
  const sy = Math.max(0, Math.min(cy - half, srcH - size));

  const off = new OffscreenCanvas(width, height);
  const ctx = off.getContext('2d')!;
  ctx.drawImage(source, sx, sy, size, size, 0, 0, width, height);
  return off.convertToBlob({ type: 'image/jpeg', quality: 0.85 });
}

/** Builds makeup-vto effects from the user's filter config. */
export function buildMakeupEffects(filter: FilterConfig) {
  const effects: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
    // skin smoothing always on (API default; keeps blend natural)
    { category: 'skin_smooth', skinSmoothStrength: 40, skinSmoothColorIntensity: 30 },
  ];
  if (filter.lipColor) {
    effects.push({
      category: 'lip_color',
      shape: { name: 'original' },
      style: { type: 'full' },
      palettes: [{ color: filter.lipColor, texture: 'matte', colorIntensity: Math.round(filter.lipOpacity * 100) }],
    });
  }
  if (filter.eyeshadow) {
    effects.push({
      category: 'eye_shadow',
      pattern: { name: '1color1' },
      palettes: [{ color: '#8B5E3C', texture: 'matte', colorIntensity: 35 }],
    });
  }
  if (filter.blush) {
    effects.push({
      category: 'blush',
      pattern: { name: '2colors6' },
      palettes: [
        { color: '#F472B6', texture: 'matte', colorIntensity: 30 },
        { color: '#F2A53E', texture: 'matte', colorIntensity: 25 },
      ],
    });
  }
  return effects;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Schema-aware parsers for YouCam V2 task results — verified against REAL
// live API responses (Aug 2026) using an actual hackathon API key:
//
//   skin-analysis (POST task/skin-analysis, format=json):
//     { status:200, data:{ error:null, task_status:"success",
//       results:{ output:[ {type:"pore", ui_score:62, raw_score:38,
//                            mask_urls:[...] }, ... ] } } }
//
//   skin-tone-analysis:
//     { status:200, data:{ error:null, task_status:"success",
//       results:{ color:{ eye_color:"#241711", eye_color_name:"Brown",
//                          lip_color:"#cc7f71", eyebrow_color:"#805d47",
//                          skin_color:"#997152", hair_color:"#B56637",
//                          hair_color_name:"Auburn" } } } }
//
// A tolerant generic walker covers any drift, but the schema-aware paths
// run first.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface SkinToneResult {
  skinToneHex: string | null;
  /** label (key path) → hex */
  colors: Record<string, string>;
  /** optional human names, e.g. eye_color_name */
  names: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface SkinAnalysisItem {
  type: string;
  uiScore: number;
  rawScore: number | null;
  maskUrls: string[];
}

export interface SkinAnalysisResult {
  /** overall skin condition 1–100 (from the "all" entry) */
  all: number | null;
  /** AI-derived skin age (from the "skin_age" entry) */
  skinAge: number | null;
  /** concern type → ui_score (1–100) */
  scores: Record<string, number>;
  items: SkinAnalysisItem[];
}

const HEX_RE = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i;

/** Digs a dotted path out of an unknown JSON tree (case-insensitive-ish). */
function dig(v: unknown, path: string[]): unknown {
  let cur: unknown = v;
  for (const key of path) {
    if (cur === null || cur === undefined || typeof cur !== 'object') return undefined;
    if (Array.isArray(cur)) {
      const idx = Number(key);
      cur = Number.isInteger(idx) ? cur[idx] : undefined;
      continue;
    }
    const obj = cur as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (key in obj) {
      cur = obj[key];
    } else {
      // case-insensitive key match
      const k = Object.keys(obj).find((k) => k.toLowerCase() === key.toLowerCase());
      cur = k ? obj[k] : undefined;
    }
  }
  return cur;
}

function normHex(s: unknown): string | null {
  if (typeof s !== 'string') return null;
  const t = s.trim().toUpperCase();
  return HEX_RE.test(t) ? t : null;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skin tone
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function parseSkinToneResult(json: unknown): SkinToneResult {
  const out: SkinToneResult = { skinToneHex: null, colors: {}, names: {} };

  const colorNode = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'color']) as
    | Record<string, unknown>
    | undefined;

  if (colorNode && typeof colorNode === 'object') {
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(colorNode)) {
      if (typeof val !== 'string') continue;
      if (HEX_RE.test(val.trim())) {
        out.colors[key] = normHex(val)!;
        if (/skin/i.test(key) && !out.skinToneHex) out.skinToneHex = normHex(val);
      } else if (/_name$/i.test(key)) {
        out.names[key] = val;
      }
    }
  }

  // fallback: generic walker
  if (out.skinToneHex === null) {
    const hits: Array<{ path: string; value: string }> = [];
    (function walk(v: unknown, path: string[]) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined) return;
      if (typeof v === 'string') {
        const h = normHex(v);
        if (h) hits.push({ path: path.join('.'), value: h });
        return;
      }
      if (typeof v !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
        v.forEach((item, i) => walk(item, [...path, String(i)]));
        return;
      }
      for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(v as Record<string, unknown>)) {
        walk(val, [...path, k]);
      }
    })(json, []);
    const skinHit = hits.find((h) => /skin/i.test(h.path)) ?? hits[0] ?? null;
    if (skinHit) {
      out.skinToneHex = skinHit.value;
      if (!(skinHit.path.split('.').pop()! in out.colors)) {
        out.colors[skinHit.path.split('.').pop()!] = skinHit.value;
      }
    }
  }

  return out;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Skin analysis
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function parseSkinAnalysisResult(json: unknown): SkinAnalysisResult {
  const out: SkinAnalysisResult = { all: null, skinAge: null, scores: {}, items: [] };

  const output = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'output']);
  if (Array.isArray(output)) {
    for (const item of output) {
      if (item === null || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
      const obj = item as Record<string, unknown>;
      const type = typeof obj.type === 'string' ? obj.type : '';
      if (!type) continue;

      // special entries
      if (type === 'all' && typeof obj.score === 'number') {
        out.all = obj.score;
        continue;
      }
      if (type === 'skin_age' && typeof obj.score === 'number') {
        out.skinAge = obj.score;
        continue;
      }
      if (type === 'resize_image') continue;

      const ui =
        typeof obj.ui_score === 'number'
          ? obj.ui_score
          : typeof obj.uiScore === 'number'
            ? obj.uiScore
            : null;
      const raw =
        typeof obj.raw_score === 'number'
          ? obj.raw_score
          : typeof obj.rawScore === 'number'
            ? obj.rawScore
            : null;
      const maskUrls = Array.isArray(obj.mask_urls)
        ? obj.mask_urls.filter((u): u is string => typeof u === 'string')
        : [];
      out.items.push({ type, uiScore: ui ?? 0, rawScore: raw, maskUrls });
      if (ui !== null) out.scores[type] = ui;
    }
  }

  const allScore = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'all']);
  if (out.all === null && typeof allScore === 'number') out.all = allScore;

  // generic fallback for "all" / score objects anywhere in the tree
  if (out.all === null && Object.keys(out.scores).length === 0) {
    const scoreHits: Array<{ label: string; score: number }> = [];
    (function walk(v: unknown, path: string[]) {
      if (v === null || v === undefined || typeof v !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
        v.forEach((item, i) => walk(item, [...path, String(i)]));
        return;
      }
      const obj = v as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof obj.all === 'number' && obj.all >= 0 && obj.all <= 100) {
        scoreHits.push({ label: 'all', score: obj.all });
      }
      const ui = obj.ui_score ?? obj.uiScore;
      if (typeof ui === 'number' && ui >= 0 && ui <= 100) {
        const label = obj.type ?? obj.name ?? path[path.length - 1] ?? 'score';
        scoreHits.push({ label: String(label), score: ui });
      }
      for (const [k, val] of Object.entries(obj)) walk(val, [...path, k]);
    })(json, []);
    for (const h of scoreHits) {
      if (h.label === 'all') out.all = h.score;
      else if (!(h.label in out.scores)) out.scores[h.label] = h.score;
    }
  }

  return out;
}

/** Glow score: the overall "all" score, else the mean of concern ui_scores. */
export function glowFromSkinAnalysis(r: SkinAnalysisResult): number | null {
  if (r.all !== null && r.all > 0) return Math.round(r.all);
  const vals = Object.values(r.scores).filter((s) => s > 0);
  if (vals.length === 0) return null;
  return Math.round(vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / vals.length);
}

/** Maps a UI cadence to a polling interval in ms (null = manual only). */
export function cadenceToMs(cadence: 'manual' | '2m' | '10m'): number | null {
  switch (cadence) {
    case '2m':
      return 120_000;
    case '10m':
      return 600_000;
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// New feature parsers (verified live Aug 2026):
//   makeup-vto:               data.results.url
//   aging:                    data.results.output[] = { res_age, url }
//   fitzpatrick-scale-analyzer: data.results.fitzpatrick_scale ("I".."VI")
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface MakeupResult {
  imageUrl: string | null;
}

export interface AgingFrame {
  age: number;
  url: string;
}

export interface AgingResult {
  frames: AgingFrame[];
}

export interface FitzpatrickResult {
  scale: string | null; // "I" .. "VI"
  /** raw metadata when present */
  timed?: number;
}

export function parseMakeupResult(json: unknown): MakeupResult {
  const url = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'url']);
  if (typeof url === 'string') return { imageUrl: url };
  // alternative shapes: results[0].download_url / results.download_url
  const arr = dig(json, ['data', 'results']);
  if (Array.isArray(arr) && typeof arr[0]?.download_url === 'string') {
    return { imageUrl: arr[0].download_url };
  }
  if (arr && typeof arr === 'object' && typeof (arr as Record<string, unknown>).download_url === 'string') {
    return { imageUrl: (arr as Record<string, unknown>).download_url as string };
  }
  return { imageUrl: null };
}

export function parseAgingResult(json: unknown): AgingResult {
  const frames: AgingFrame[] = [];
  const output = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'output']);
  if (Array.isArray(output)) {
    for (const item of output) {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') continue;
      const obj = item as Record<string, unknown>;
      if (typeof obj.url === 'string' && typeof obj.res_age === 'number') {
        frames.push({ age: obj.res_age, url: obj.url });
      }
    }
  }
  frames.sort((a, b) => a.age - b.age);
  return { frames };
}

export function parseFitzpatrickResult(json: unknown): FitzpatrickResult {
  const scale = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'fitzpatrick_scale']);
  const timed = dig(json, ['data', 'results', 'timed']);
  return {
    scale: typeof scale === 'string' ? scale : null,
    timed: typeof timed === 'number' ? timed : undefined,
  };
}

# VirtuFit 👗✨

## 🌐 **Try it live: https://yashwanth07-debug.github.io/virtufit/**

**AI virtual try-on in your browser. No account. Nothing stored.**

Upload a selfie + a garment → get a realistic preview of you wearing it in ~20 seconds.
Powered by the **YouCam cloth-v3** virtual try-on API.

## 🎬 Demo video

▶ **Watch on YouTube:** [youtu.be/QBXrbp-O_5w](https://youtu.be/QBXrbp-O_5w)

Play it right here (or [download the MP4](demo/virtufit-demo.mp4)) — a 54-second walkthrough with narration: pick a person, pick a garment, real AI try-on, download the result.

<video controls width="100%" src="demo/virtufit-demo.mp4"></video>

## 🔒 Privacy-first by design (no backend at all)

- **Zero backend** — pure static frontend. The only network call is the try-on request to the YouCam API (CORS-enabled, client key).
- **Nothing is stored** — images exist as in-memory blob URLs in your tab and are discarded the moment you close it. No database, no cookies.
- The result is yours: **download it** or **share it** via the OS share sheet.

## 🚀 Run it

```bash
npm ci
cp .env.example .env    # add your YouCam API key (optional — see below)
npm run dev             # http://localhost:5273
```

**No key? It still runs** in *demo mode* (a sample result replays the full flow, clearly labeled). Add a key to get real results:

1. Get a key: **https://yce.makeupar.com/api-console** (hackathon participants get 1,000 free units)
2. `VITE_YOUCAM_KEY=your-key` in `.env`
3. Restart — the app auto-switches from demo to real mode (badge shows "✨ YouCam AI")

## 🧱 How it works

```
You (photo) ─┐
             ├─► YouCam cloth-v3  ──► result (in-memory)
Garment ─────┘      (~2 units · ~15–30s)
```

- Person photo: front-facing, 3:4 works best, upper body visible
- Garment: single clean flat-lay product photo (or browse the built-in sample catalog)
- Results: **before/after compare**, **download**, **share**, seed control for variety

## ✨ Features

- 3-step flow: person photo → garment → run
- 12 sample person photos + 12 sample garment photos (try instantly, no uploads needed)
- Seed slider + random seed, "Seed used" / "Response" readouts
- Showcase gallery of person + garment → result pairs
- Fully responsive, works on phone & laptop

## 📦 Stack

React 18 + Vite + TypeScript · no other deps · deploys to GitHub Pages (auto-deploy on push).

## 🗂️ Files

```
virtufit/
├─ src/
│  ├─ App.tsx          # the whole product (3-step flow, seed, result)
│  ├─ tryon.ts         # provider adapter: YouCam (real) | mock (demo, no key)
│  ├─ main.tsx
│  └─ styles.css       # clean card design system
├─ public/assets/      # sample person/garment photos + showcase + demo result
├─ .env.example
└─ README.md
```

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const r = new FileReader();
